articles.title: Skydance Co-CEO Ynon Kreiz Spotlights “Moral Responsibility” And Combating Antisemitism & Injustice In Simon Wiesenthal Gala Speech
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Dominic Patten Dominic Patten Executive Editor, Legal, Labor & Politics @DeadlineDominic More Stories By Dominic Skydance Co-CEO Ynon Kreiz Spotlights “Moral Responsibility” And Combating Antisemitism & Injustice In Simon Wiesenthal Gala Speech Hasan Piker’s $72.5M Defamation Suit Over Lynching Quotes Should Be Tossed Out, Scott Jennings Says; Statements Are “Literally True,” CNN Contributor Claims Ted Sarandos Faces Unrest From Past & Present Netflix Execs Over Streamer’s Direction – The Dish View All November 11, 2026 11:29pm Add us as a Google Preferred Source (L-R) David Ellison, Ynon Kreiz and Gal Gadot Skydance/Courtesy “Defending Israel does not mean Israel is beyond criticism,” said Skydance ‘s Ynon Kriez bluntly tonight after being presented the Simon Wiesenthal Center ‘s (SWC) 2026 Humanitarian Award by his co-CEO David Ellison , Gal Gadot and Jeffrey Katzenberg. “The fight against antisemitism is a fight against hatred in any form,” the ex-Mattel boss added. Thanking Ellison for his “bold stand for Israel and the Jewish people,” Kriez wasted no time at the Beverly Wilshire hosted function addressing contemporary attacks on Jews and its rise around the globe in his acceptance speech. “Israel is now confronting a very different world beyond its borders,” he observed, referencing the horrific October 7, 2023 attacks on the Jewish state and the digital spears of the 21st century. “Ancient hatred has found new platforms on which to spread.” To that, Kreiz put the focus on himself, Ellison and Skydance, and the platforms they possess, to combat the spread of hate. “We recognize that business leadership comes with moral responsibility,” the co-CEO stated, reading the room. Watch on Deadline Related Stories Executives Ted Sarandos Faces Unrest From Past & Present Netflix Execs Over Streamer’s Direction – The Dish News Gal Gadot Producing With Eye To Star In Adaptation Of Bianna Golodryga & Yonit Levi’s Book ‘Don’t Feed The Lion’ In Works At Fox Entertainment Studios In many ways, tonight’s beautillion ball had a sense of déjà vu. Perhaps more accurately, it was a reimagining, with many of the same personalities and execs in the ballroom as last year’s Wiesenthal gala , but a very different vibe. Once again, a CEO got the big award and a CNN host (Dana Bash last year, former anchor Brianna Golodryga tonight) received the Jewish Heritage Award earlier in the ceremony. Once again, Shari Redstone plus Cheryl & Haim Saban were among the event’s chairs. Once again, there was Ellison and his inner corporate circle in the Skydance sponsored packed ballroom. Top agents, and top entertainment lawyers like the Glaser Weil crew were back and backing the event. No surprise, SWC CEO Jim Berk, and SWC trustee and Dinner Chair Katzenberg were there in person to set the table and direct the awards traffic Though their names were on the program, gala co-chair Ted Sarandos , and chair David Zaslav were missing in action this year. Once attending almost every opening and gala during his stint running Warner Bros. Discovery, Zas has disappeared from town since Paramount’s $111 billion purchase of the Burbank studio finally closed earlier this year, with the ex-CEO pocketing a very lucrative $600 million exit.

articles.title: Lionel Uzan Succeeding Pascal Breton As President Of Federation Studios; Montefiore Ups Stake
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Max Goldbart Max Goldbart International TV Co-Editor @Goldbart1 More Stories By Max BBC Boss Matt Brittin & Industry Leaders Set To Attend Culture Secretary’s Emergency Meeting Next Week Following Brand & Walliams Scandals ‘Bridgerton’ Star Adjoa Andoh Co-Creating & Starring In ITV Detective Drama ‘Protect And Serve’ Barbara Broccoli Appointed President Of UK’s National Film & Television School View All November 12, 2026 12:59am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Pascal Breton (left) and Lionel Uzan Federation Studios Federation Studios ’ Lionel Uzan is taking the reins at the French entertainment giant with Pascal Breton stepping back, as Montefiore Investments becomes a majority shareholder. Federation, which had been seeking a huge cash injection of hundreds of millions of euros for the past couple of years , will have a new structure with an increase of capital whereby Montefiore, which previously had a 33% stake, becomes a majority shareholder alongside other financial investors. The group said today it will now “refocus its strategy on its most promising markets, and on scripted content.” Watch on Deadline Related Stories News Apple TV Buys Tropic Noir Series 'Dustfall' Starring Anna Torv News David Michel Buys Cottonwood Media Out Of Federation Studios According to Federation, the new structure will “strengthen” its “equity base and significantly reduce its debt level.” Federation declined comment on financials or how much of a stake Montefiore now has. Breton, who founded Federation more than a decade ago, is becoming chairman of the supervisory board while Uzan, who joined in 2015, succeeds him as President. Uzan will be supported by an executive board comprising Éric Broet, Cosette Liebgott, Simona Rapino and Chiraz Zribi. Co-MD Marco Chimenz left earlier this year. Federation stressed that Breton “remains fully involved in the group’s development as both a shareholder and producer.” The Montefiore move represents a U-turn from what bosses told Deadline last year. In 2025, when they signaled they were seeking hundreds of millions in investment, Breton told us: “We have 55 producers [within the company] and feel we can double that in the next two to three years, so we want to replace Montefiore and find a stronger partner for the future.” At that point bosses declined to say how much of a stake they wanted to sell in Federation but were valuing the business at around the €500M to €600M ($554M to $665M) mark. Montefiore invested €50M in Federation in 2021. BNP Paribas and Bpifrance are also minority investors. Federation owns a whole range of indies around Europe and has in recent years pivoted to big English-language projects like A Tale of Two Cities, Around the World in 80 Days and a planned Gulliver’s Travels . It is also behind French hit The Bureau and Showtime’s subsequent U.S. remake The Agency, on which Breton was an EP amongst the likes of George Clooney. Last month, kids TV veteran David Michel bought back control of Find Me in Paris maker Cottonwood Media from Federation. Federation has operations across Paris, Berlin, Cologne, L.A., London, Madrid, Rome and Tel-Aviv. articles.title: Barbara Broccoli Appointed President Of UK’s National Film & Television School
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Max Goldbart Max Goldbart International TV Co-Editor @Goldbart1 More Stories By Max ‘Bridgerton’ Star Adjoa Andoh Co-Creating & Starring In ITV Detective Drama ‘Protect And Serve’ Barbara Broccoli Appointed President Of UK’s National Film & Television School Lionel Uzan Succeeding Pascal Breton As President Of Federation Studios; Montefiore Ups Stake View All November 12, 2026 1:00am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Barbara Broccoli EON Productions Limited EXCLUSIVE: Barbara Broccoli has been named the first female president of the UK’s National Film and Television School ( NFTS ). The storied James Bond producer becomes President just a few weeks before the opening of a building dedicated to her father, the legendary Cubby Broccoli. Barbara Broccoli will build on her longstanding relationship with the NFTS and commitment to championing emerging filmmaking talent. She succeeds David Puttnam , another iconic British producer who takes on the honorary role of President Emeritus in recognition of his outstanding contribution to the NFTS and its continued success. Related Stories News Pippa Harris & YouTube UK Boss Alison Lomax Join Board Of National Film & Television School News The Sidemen & NFTS Team To Train Next Generation Of Unscripted Producers In UK Broccoli is one of the industry’s most influential producers. She and her brother Michael G. Wilson were given an Honorary Academy Award in 2024. A year later she handed creative control of the iconic James Bond spy franchise to Amazon MGM Studios. The world is now eagerly anticipating Amazon’s announcement over who will play the next 007. Watch on Deadline The NFTS’ Cubby Broccoli Building at its Beaconsfield campus will open in a few weeks. Officially named by Barbara Broccoli earlier this year in honour of her late father, the building will provide teaching facilities, creative spaces and the school’s first on-site student accommodation. Broccoli said: “It’s a tremendous honour to become President of the National Film and Television School, following in Lord David Puttnam’s footsteps. Having been involved with the NFTS for many years, I have seen first-hand the extraordinary talent it develops and the vital role it plays in shaping the future of our industry. With the opening of The Cubby Broccoli Building taking place in January, this is especially meaningful. My father believed in the power of filmmaking and in giving talented people the opportunity to succeed.” NFTS chair Sophie Turner Laing welcomed the “landmark moment” and thanked Puttnam, “whose support, wisdom and unwavering belief in the NFTS have been invaluable.” Last month, British producer Pippa Harris and YouTube UK boss Alison Lomax joined the NFTS board . articles.title: ‘Bridgerton’ Star Adjoa Andoh Co-Creating & Starring In ITV Detective Drama ‘Protect And Serve’
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Max Goldbart Max Goldbart International TV Co-Editor @Goldbart1 More Stories By Max BBC Boss Matt Brittin & Industry Leaders Set To Attend Culture Secretary’s Emergency Meeting Next Week Following Brand & Walliams Scandals ‘Bridgerton’ Star Adjoa Andoh Co-Creating & Starring In ITV Detective Drama ‘Protect And Serve’ Barbara Broccoli Appointed President Of UK’s National Film & Television School View All November 12, 2026 1:30am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Adjoa Andoh Shonay EXCLUSIVE: Bridgerton star Adjoa Andoh is swapping Shonda Rhimes’ regency wonderland for an ITV detective drama. Andoh is creating her first drama series, Protect and Serve [working title], with Time scribe Helen Black . Andoh will play the lead, DI Araba Dadzie, a cop, mother and daughter. Araba is in the squeezed middle of her life, juggling profession, elderly parents and children. She embarks on an investigation into the tragic shooting of a teenage boy, who has been living in a privately-owned children’s care home with his brother since his grandfather fell ill. Related Stories News ITV Cutting $40M From Media & Entertainment Budget Due To Weak Advertising Market News 'Britain's Got Talent' Producer Urges "Anyone Who Feels They Have Been Subject Of Wrongdoing" To Come Forward Following David Walliams Allegations Set in Leeds, Protect and Serve comes from Ludwig producer Big Talk Studios and is Andoh’s first TV creation. Nimer Rashed, director of Harlen Coben smashes Run Away and Missing You , will direct with Stella Nwimo producing. Watch on Deadline Andoh is best known for playing the sharp-witted Lady Agatha Danbury across four seasons of Netflix’s Bridgerton along with spin-off Queen Charlotte. Season 5 is coming next year. Past credits include Invictus and Fractured. Andoh is creating Protect and Serve with Black, who wrote on hit BBC prison drama Time and penned the same network’s Life and Death in the Warehouse. “How does a woman juggle an aging father, a chippy student daughter and a non-existent sex life, while investigating murders as a black female cop,” said Andoh. “That’s the lot of DI Araba Dadzie, Senior Investigation Officer on a Homicide and Major Enquiry Team in central Leeds. It’s a job that costs, a job that we the public need, and in spite of the challenges, it’s a job Araba feels called to, much like a priest or a teacher.” The series will commence filming early 2027 with further casting news coming closer to production. Big Talk boss Kenton Allen is exec producing alongside Andoh and Black. Jenny van der Lande, who is soon exiting Big Talk to launch a BBC Studios-backed label, introduced and developed the drama and executive produces alongside Chris Clough ( Mr Bates vs The Post Office ) . Protect and Serve will be produced in association with, and distributed internationally by, ITV Studios . articles.title: Nicole Kidman To Receive Honorary César In France
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Melanie Goodfellow Melanie Goodfellow Senior International Film Correspondent @mel_goodfellow More Stories By Melanie Marrakech Unveils 2026 Jury With Claes Bang, Kaouther Ben Hania & Vicky Krieps Nicole Kidman To Receive Honorary César In France May El-Toukhy’s Venice Golden Lion Winner ‘Woman Unknown’ Gets U.S. Deal During AFM View All November 12, 2026 1:30am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Nicole Kidman Jamie McCarthy/Getty Images Nicole Kidman will be feted with an Honorary César at the 52nd César Ceremony in Paris in February 2027. She follows in the wake of Jim Carrey (2026) Julia Roberts (2025), Christopher Nolan (2024), David Fincher (2023) Cate Blanchett (2022), Robert Redford (2019) and George Clooney (2017). The Australian actress has worked with a number of directors who the French hold dear including Stanley Kubrick, Jane Campion, Lars von Trier, Baz Luhrmann, and Yorgos Lanthimos, among many others. After breaking out internationally with Dead Calm , she went onto win acclaim for performances in films such as Moulin Rouge !, Eyes Wide Shut , The Others , and Dogville . Related Stories Books All The Songs In 'Practical Magic 2': Stevie Nicks, Olivia Rodrigo & More Reviews 'Practical Magic 2' Review: Sandra Bullock-Nicole Kidman Sequel Lacks Magic Of Original But Lays Groundwork For Trilogy Her portrayal of Virginia Woolf in The Hours earned her the Academy Award for Best Actress in 2003. Watch on Deadline More recently, she received the Volpi Cup for Best Actress at the 2024 Venice Film Festival for her role in Babygirl. Also active as a producer, Nicole Kidman co-founded Blossom Films, the production company behind series such as Big Little Lies , The Undoing , and Nine Perfect Strangers , projects in which she also starred. Kidman has also won acclaim on the stage with her performances in London in The Blue Room and Photograph 51 . Her previous career recognitions include a Companion of the Order of Australia in 2006; the Cannes Film Festival’s 70th Anniversary Award in 2017, and the AFI Life Achievement Award in 2024, as the first Australian to receive the honor. The 52nd César Awards, overseen by France’s Académie des Arts et Techniques du Cinéma with the support of payTV giant Canal+, will take place in the Olympia Theater in Paris on February 25, 2027. articles.title: Elijah Wood Says “Muscle Memory” Kicked In Playing Frodo On ‘The Hunt For Gollum’ Set
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Glenn Garner , Tom Tapp November 12, 2026 2:09am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Elijah Wood Amy Sussman/Getty Images Elijah Wood told Deadline tonight that playing Frodo again after more than two decades was “beautiful and surreal and it felt like no time had passed.” Wood reprised the role earlier this year on director Andy Serkis’ new Middle-earth set tale, The Hunt For Gollum . Related Stories News Andy Serkis Directs ‘The Hunt For Gollum’ In Character: See The Set Footage News ‘The Lord Of The Rings: The Hunt For Gollum’: Everything We Know So Far The actor has spoken in anticipation of returning to the part, but these may be his first public observations after having done so. Serkis confirmed yesterday that principal photography for the film has now wrapped. The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum reunites beloved figures from across Middle-earth, including Ian McKellen as Gandalf, Wood as Frodo and Lee Pace as Thranduil. New actors announced for the film include Anya Taylor-Joy, Kate Winslet, Jamie Dornan and Leo Woodall. Serkis directs and returns as Gollum in the film. Watch on Deadline “I think it really is a creative ‘getting the band back together.” Wood told Screen Rant before production in January. “It’s very much that core original group getting back together to tell this story that will feel like a really fun exploration of this character that we all love so much.” Wood spoke tonight about being on set in his costume and hobbit feet again. “It felt like stepping back into time. You know, looking down…having this sort of muscle memory that I’ve seen these feet this way. I know this wardrobe. And that feeling is so wild. It’s so transportive. Suddenly 27 years are gone and you’re back in it again.” Elijah Wood on returning as Frodo for ‘The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt For Gollum’ pic.twitter.com/srVYx98Ud4 — Deadline (@DEADLINE) November 12, 2026 The Hunt for Gollum follows Aragorn’s perilous quest to capture Gollum before the creature can reveal the One Ring’s location to Sauron. The story, much of it developed from Tolkien’s footnotes, is set between the events of The Hobbit and The Fellowship of the Ring . Last month, Serkis posted a video slideshow from the set. One of the final images shows what looks to be Wood as Frodo entering Bilbo’s hobbit house. You can watch it below. View this post on Instagram Warner Bros. Pictures will release The Lord of the Rings : The Hunt for Gollum worldwide on December 17, 2027. articles.title: ‘Line Of Duty’: Arnott, Fleming & Hastings Return To Service In First Look At Season 7 Of BBC’s Record-Setting Cop Drama
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Jesse Whittock Jesse Whittock International TV Co-Editor @WhittockTweets More Stories By Jesse Jeff Goldblum To Narrate Cliburn Piano Competition Doc Series ‘Exit Stage Right’ ‘Line Of Duty’: Arnott, Fleming & Hastings Return To Service In First Look At Season 7 Of BBC’s Record-Setting Cop Drama Gang Dong-won & Kim Go-eun To Lead Netflix Korea Romance-Action Period Drama ‘The Twilight Between Us’ From Kim Won-suk View All November 12, 2026 2:50am Add us as a Google Preferred Source First look at 'Line of Duty' Season 7 BBC “Jesus, Mary, and Joseph and the wee donkey!” Martin Compston , Vicky McClure and Adrian Dunbar reprise their roles as Steve Arnott, Kate Fleming and Ted Hastings, respectively in the first look at the much anticipated return of record-setting BBC cop drama Line of Duty , along with a sight of Robert Carlyle ‘s character, Shaun Massie. Season 7 of the show, which was announced in November last year amid wild speculation the ratings behemoth from Jed Mercurio series would return, will see the anti-corruption cops returning at the now rebranded Inspectorate of Professional Standards, which replaces the famous AC-12. Related Stories News James Graham's BBC Drama 'Sherwood' To End After Season 3 News Channel 4 Becomes Latest Network To Delete David Walliams Shows There are the usual shots of the trio sat stoically in police interview rooms, along with a first look at Robert Carlyle, who is the guest lead for the series, playing Specialist Rifle Officer (SRO) Massie. His character is a veteran marksman who usually keeps a low profile only to drastically change his demeanor when his commanding officer, DI Dominic Gough ( Tom Weston-Jones ) is accused of being a sexual predator. Watch on Deadline The series will explore whether the accusations made against Gough, a charismatic TO-7 officer known for a string of organized crime takedowns, is a deliberate distraction from a bigger threat lurking in the shadows. Other actors in TO-7 team include Laura Aikman as DC Paula Beckman, Levi Brown as DC Luke Tobin, and Amy Leigh Hickman as DC Nira Rashid. Mark Bonnar, Owen Teale, Perry Fitzpatrick and Christina Chong all return to reprise their roles, with new cast members including David Calder, Steven Elder, Dominic Mafham, Aimee Powell and Naomi Yang. It has been over five years since the sixth season of Line of Duty went out in the UK, achieving huge average overnight ratings of nearly 10 million and 13 million+ consolidated. Having begun life as a relatively small BBC Two drama, the ratings grew exponentially and the final episode of Season 6 on BBC One remains the most-watched British drama episode since records began with more than 15.2 million consolidated viewers. The conclusion divided fans as the identity of ‘H’, the figure pulling the strings behind the scenes, was revealed. Each season of the show has brought in one high-profile actor who plays a morally grey character under AC-12’s suspicion. The likes of Stephen Graham, Lennie James, Daniel Mays and Keeley Hawes have all featured, and Carlyle now joins that band. Mercurio wrote and created season seven, and also directed episodes 4-6. World Productions returned to make the show in association with parent company ITV Studios, which is handling international distribution. Jennie Darnell directed the first three episodes, and the producers are Ken Horn and Richard Burnell. The executive producers are Mercurio, Simon Heath for World and Nick Lambon for the BBC. Northern Ireland Screen provided support. articles.title: BBC Boss Matt Brittin & Industry Leaders Set To Attend Culture Secretary’s Emergency Meeting Next Week Following Brand & Walliams Scandals
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Max Goldbart Max Goldbart International TV Co-Editor @Goldbart1 More Stories By Max BBC Boss Matt Brittin & Industry Leaders Set To Attend Culture Secretary’s Emergency Meeting Next Week Following Brand & Walliams Scandals ‘Bridgerton’ Star Adjoa Andoh Co-Creating & Starring In ITV Detective Drama ‘Protect And Serve’ Barbara Broccoli Appointed President Of UK’s National Film & Television School View All November 12, 2026 3:08am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Culture Secretary Lisa Nandy and BBC boss Matt Brittin Getty EXCLUSIVE: BBC Director General Matt Brittin is one of a number of industry bosses who will attend an emergency meeting convened by the UK Culture Secretary next week in the wake of the Russell Brand , David Walliams and MAFS scandals. Nandy will tell a meeting of leaders that if their response to the recent allegations is not robust enough, she may consider introducing legislation to force them to fund the just-launched CIISA anonymous whistleblowing service. Earlier today, she told parliament: “I want to be clear that if protections are insufficient, the government will not hesitate to take further action. For too long, too many people have had to choose between their careers and safety. People must be safe in their jobs, whistleblowers must be protected and those who abuse their position must no longer be able to hide.” Related Stories News 'Line Of Duty': Arnott, Fleming & Hastings Return To Service In First Look At Season 7 Of BBC's Record-Setting Cop Drama News Meta Removes Russell Brand's Instagram & Facebook Account After Rape Conviction Deadline is told invitations to attend Nandy’s meeting landed with the big broadcasters and Sky yesterday. BBC DG Brittin will almost definitely attend, we understand. Others are considering who will attend from their organizations but it would be no surprise if they send their most senior individual, especially if Brittin goes. Earlier this week, Brittin emailed all BBC employees with title “Building the culture we want” to say “there is still more to do to engage with staff and represent their views” to try and stamp these problems out. He said he will be speaking to trade unions about changes that could be made immediately and in the next charter. Deadline understands Phillipa Childs, who runs broadcasting union Bectu, will attend Nandy’s meeting. Watch on Deadline We are told the Nandy meeting could happen as soon as Monday. She has made cleaning up the TV industry’s bad behavior problem one of the cornerstones of her time as Culture Secretary and has been enraged by the latest high-profile examples. Nandy’s idea is that the big networks and production groups could be forced to fund CIISA each year. This is not a new argument. Deadline revealed nearly two years ago, before CIISA was up and running properly, that Nandy was considering legislation that would force UK broadcasters to regularly fund the body , which emerged from the Noel Clarke scandal and Time’s Up UK movement. The whistleblowing service opened a few weeks ago in earnest but regular donations are required to keep it running, especially if there is an influx of complaints following these high-profile allegations. The body would also like to expand its scope at some point to areas like arbitration. CIISA representatives have been invited to Nandy’s meeting and we understand CIISA will host an event in parliament later this month. CIISA has indicated that running costs would be around £1.5M ($2M) in its first year, rising to just more than £2M the following one to fund its small team and operations. The body has floated a funding model based on organizations paying an ongoing yearly contribution of a maximum 0.1% of their annual turnover. Current financial backers include the likes of the BBC, ITV, Sky and big production groups. Nandy and other senior government ministers are also focused on non-disclosure agreements, with Bridget Phillipson, the UK’s womens and equalities minister, telling Sky News such agreements should not be “abused in order to silence women.” All this has contributed to a feeling within the industry that enough is enough. An open letter has been doing the rounds , signed by dozens of actors, writers and directors, which is titled “Let’s make this a turning point” and urges industry action. “We call on every union, every company and every industry organisation to stop enabling a systemic cycle of abuse, whether through unconscious inaction or deliberate distraction,” it reads. “Review your processes. Protect those who speak out. Become less offended by your inaction being named than you are by the actions you are being asked to recognise.” Brand was sentenced earlier this week to 10-and-a-half years in prison for rape and sexual assault and the TV industry has been heavily implicated, with one of the women he sexually assaulted working for Channel 4 at the time. Earlier this week, The Guardian and ITV News published allegations against of sexually exploitative activity against women and girls from Walliams, allegations that he denies. Meanwhile, Channel 4 axed Married at First Sight last week after rape allegations. articles.title: EST N8 Closes Six-Title Americas Deal With DuBow Media, Led By Indonesian Hits ‘Janur Ireng’ & ‘Danur’ – AFM
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Liz Shackleton Liz Shackleton pmc-media-editor-2024 More Stories By Liz California Pictures Boards World Sales On Bengali Gothic Horror ‘The Undying’ — AFM Vietnamese Musical Hit ‘A Little Dream Of Me’ Set For North American Release Through Reel Citrus Asian World Film Festival Reveals Asian Vision & Focus On Sections View All November 12, 2026 8:00am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Danur: The Last Chapter MD Entertainment EXCLUSIVE: Los Angeles-based financing, sales and distribution outfit EST N8 has closed a six-title deal with DuBow Media Distribution (DMD) for North and South America. The deal, announced during AFM, is led by two of Indonesia’s biggest recent box office hits, both produced by MD Pictures : Janur Ireng: Sewu Dino The Prequel and Danur: The Last Chapter . DMD takes all rights across the region including theatrical, home entertainment and digital, with releases rolling out across 2027. Directed by Kimo Stamboel ( The Queen Of Black Magic ), Janur Ireng is the origin story behind his 2023 hit Sewu Dino , which topped Indonesia’s box office that year with 4.9 million admissions. Watch on Deadline Related Stories News EST N8 Picks Up Manila-Set Crime Thriller 'Jaguar' With Elijah Canlas, David Call, Sid Lucero & Gabby Padilla News EST N8 Takes Worldwide Rights To Bangladeshi Rotterdam Winner 'Master' The prequel crossed 1 million admissions in its first 12 days and made its North American premiere at Fantastic Fest in Austin, giving U.S. genre audiences a first look ahead of its release with DMD. Awi Suryadi’s Danur: The Last Chapter closes a franchise drawn from Risa Saraswati’s bestselling books, which has pulled in a combined 11 million admissions. The Last Chapter opened over this year’s Eid holiday and ranked as the country’s top-grossing release of the first half of 2026 with 3.62 million admissions. Both films were produced by Manoj Punjabi, founder of MD Pictures, Indonesia’s largest film studio and the first listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange. The studio’s hits also include KKN di Desa Penari , one of the highest-grossing Indonesian films of all time with more than 10 million admissions. EST N8 has also worked with the studio on recent titles Sugar Factory ( Pabrik Gula ), Sorop and Perewangan . Rounding out the package with DuBow Media are Hanung Bramantyo’s occult thriller The Hole , which premiered at International Film Festival Rotterdam; Busan selection Dear Stranger , a New York-set drama starring Hidetoshi Nishijima ( Drive My Car ) and Gwei Lun-Mei; Korean time-loop thriller 30 Minute s, directed by William Inhyuk Hyoung ( Chabak ), and Philippine folk horror The Caretakers , starring Iza Calzado and Dimples Romana. Jan Paul Villanueva, EVP of acquisitions and global distribution at EST N8, brokered the deal alongside head of sales and U.S. distribution Cathy Ni and global sales and marketing executive Shams Pasha, with DMD’s VP of global sales, acquisitions and co-productions, Jonathan DuBow. “Audiences are hungry for bold, original storytelling, and right now, Asia is producing some of the most exciting genre films in the world,” said Villanueva. “This package pairs two of Indonesia’s biggest box office hits with standout titles from Japan, Korea, and the Philippines. We saw firsthand at Fantastic Fest how positively U.S. fans responded to Janur Iren g. We’re thrilled to partner with DMD to bring these films to North America and LATAM.” DMD is run by Ken DuBow, whose has worked in distribution for four decades, including executive roles at MGM/UA, Disney and First Look Studios, and was also involved in the sale of Modern Entertainment’s 324-title library, including the Dirty Dancing and Halloween films, to Lionsgate. Jonathan DuBow who joined DMD from Cinema Management Group, where he worked on titles including Loving Vincent , said: “We’re thrilled to take on this multi-title package from EST N8, led by two of Indonesia’s biggest box office hits and rounded out by films with real range from across Asia. We’re excited to bring them to audiences across the Americas, and we look forward to being first in line for whatever EST N8 brings next.” Manoj Punjabi said: “We are proud to see Indonesian films reaching wider audiences across the Americas. The success of Janur Ireng and Danur: The Last Chapter reflects the strength of our local stories and the growing appetite for Indonesian cinema beyond our borders. “At MD Pictures, we believe great stories transcend language and culture. This partnership with EST N8 and DuBow Media is another important step in bringing Indonesian storytelling to the world, and we look forward to building more opportunities for our films in the international market.” EST N8 previously sold Sugar Factory and Perewanga n to Shudder. The company’s current slate also includes Marco Balsamo’s Bali-set football drama Forza , J-horror The Invisible Half , Manila crime thriller Jaguar , Thai horror TAME and Annecy-selected animation Pilgrim s. articles.title: Watermelon Pictures Condemns Killing Of ‘American Doctor’ Surgeon In Gaza Hospital Strike
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Melanie Goodfellow Melanie Goodfellow Senior International Film Correspondent @mel_goodfellow More Stories By Melanie Watermelon Pictures Condemns Killing Of ‘American Doctor’ Surgeon In Gaza Hospital Strike Doha Film Festival Cancels ‘Fing!’ International Premiere Marrakech Unveils 2026 Jury With Claes Bang, Kaouther Ben Hania & Vicky Krieps View All November 12, 2026 8:08am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Dr. Rizk Abu Shaaira (far right) with colleagues at the Nasser Medical Complex in Gaza Watermelon Pictures Palestinian surgeon Dr. Rizk Abu Shaaira, who appears in the documentary American Doctor , was killed on Wednesday in an Israeli airstrike on the Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Younis, southern Gaza . Watermelon Pictures , which is handling North American distribution of the film by Poh Si Teng, put out a release on Thursday saying it was “appalled and devastated’ by the news reported by Reuters news agencies and other outlets. It noted that Dr. Mohammed Odainy, another Palestinian surgeon featured in American Doctor , was also critically injured in the attack and is fighting for his life. Both physicians worked at Nasser Medical Complex, providing lifesaving care. Watch on Deadline Related Stories Documentary India's Yellowstone International Film Festival Announces Documentary And LGBTQIA+ Slates News 'NAZA' Becomes One Of The Most Watched Docs On Theatrical Release In 2026 “We are horrified and heartbroken by the killing of Dr. Rizk Abu Shaaira. This is yet another devastating example of the continued violence against Gaza’s medical community. Hospitals are places of healing, not targets of war. We condemn this attack in the strongest possible terms and call for accountability and an end to the destruction of Gaza’s healthcare system,” said Watermelon Pictures co-founder Hamza Ali. American Doctor follows three American physicians – Dr. Thaer Ahmad, Dr. Mark Perlmutter and Dr. Feroze Sidhwa – who travel to Gaza to provide lifesaving medical care and return home determined to bear witness to the humanitarian catastrophe they encountered. “Operating with another surgeon is an intimate partnership. You learn their cadence, their strengths and weaknesses, and even glimpse their confidences and fears,” said Sidhwa. “Dr. Rizk Abu Shaaira and I performed a complex surgery on a man with shrapnel injuries, while Dr. Mohammed Odainy and I operated on a teenager after an American-made bomb tore a hole in his abdominal aorta. Remarkably, the child lived. These two men were my friends, colleagues and an inspiration. Now Dr. Rizk is dead and Dr. Mohammed is fighting for his life. It was an unforgivable crime.” Director Teng, who felt compelled to make the film after hearing orthopaedic surgeon Perlmutter talk about his experiences of working in Gaza, also voiced her distress at the news. “Dr. Abu Shaaira was among the extraordinary medical professionals whose courage and humanity we sought to honor through American Doctor. His death is devastating and a painful reminder that the crisis documented in our film continues. Those who dedicate their lives to saving others deserve protection, not violence,” she said. Close to 75,000 people have been killed and another 176,000 have been injured in Gaza since the beginning of the Israeli military campaign in the Palestinian territory, sparked by the Hamas-led terror attacks on Southern Israel on October 7, 2023. Within that, at least 1,600 people have been killed and close to another 6,000 have been injured since a ceasefire was called on October 11, 2025. In the backdrop, 65 per cent of Gaza’s population, about 1.4 million people, is currently living in tents or makeshift shelters after Israel’s bombing campaign reduced residential neighborhoods and key infrastructure to rubble. The film stars Moises Arias ( Fallout , Monos ), Rain Spencer ( The Summer I Turned Pretty ), Piper Perabo ( Yellowstone ) and Simon Rex ( Red Rocket ). The story is said to “examine the increasingly blurred boundaries between human emotion and artificial intelligence.” Shot on location in Iceland, the full synopsis reads: ANSWR follows Colton Ray (Arias), a young man struggling with profound grief who isolates himself at a remote weather station in hopes of finding peace. His solitude takes a disturbing turn when he begins experimenting with an advanced AI chatbot (Spencer) designed to provide unwavering empathy, understanding, and emotional support. As their connection intensifies, Colton becomes increasingly dependent on the technology, setting off a psychological unraveling that threatens to destroy his sense of reality. Related Stories News Aura Entertainment Takes U.S. Rights To Louis L'Amour Adaptation 'Flint' Starring Josh Holloway -- AFM News Dylan Sprouse, Barbie Ferreira & Tanner Buchanan Lead Hamptons Thriller 'The Sleeping Dogs Of Southampton' -- AFM “We wanted to make a film about the need for connection in an increasingly isolated world,” Kay said in a statement. “It’s a story about AI, sure. But it’s really a story about grief and loneliness and how hard it is sometimes to just be a person—especially in a time when machines have been built to present as the answer to all our problems. I’m super excited to have Dark Sky bring the movie to theaters.” Watch on Deadline The cast also features Lilli Kay ( Your Honor , Stick ), José María Yazpik ( Narcos: Mexico ), and Siddiq Saunderson ( Wu-Tang: An American Saga ). ANSWR is produced by Stephen Kay, Natalya Pavchinskya, Jomon Thomas, Sarena Khan, Sharad Devarajan, Timur Bekmambetov, and Adam Sidman, with production companies S’YA Concept ( Monkey Man ), Bazelevs ( Mercy ), Graphic India, and Barking Dog Productions on the project. It was negotiated at the American Film Market by Greg Newman, Executive Vice President of Dark Sky Films, and Jessica Lacy of Gersh on behalf of the filmmakers. articles.title: Eddie Murphy & Ama Qamata Voicing Animated Fantasy Movie ‘M’Tali: The Everlasting Spring’
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Andreas Wiseman , Zac Ntim November 12, 2026 8:16am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Eddie Murphy and Ama Qamata Kwaku Alston/Thickleeyonce EXCLUSIVE: Eddie Murphy is set to voice animated family fantasy M’Tali: The Everlasting Spring alongside South African actress Ama Qamata ( Blood & Water ). The original story, which is being written by Eddie Murphy’s daughter Bria Murphy and Michael Xavier, “follows Princess Selani of the African kingdom of M’tali who longs for adventure but quietly dreads the responsibilities waiting for her as future queen. When a coup separates her from her family and kingdom, she finds herself in the Forbidden Jungle inhabited by a mysterious family who have discovered the legendary Everlasting Spring, a magical water said to preserve youth forever. There she must reckon with her uncle’s ambitions and uncover what, beyond any single artifact, truly sustains a kingdom.” Related Stories News Matthew Weiner Exits Eddie Murphy Peacock Series 'The Chairman' As Showrunner Casting Eddie Murphy Moves Into Scripted TV With 'The Chairman' For Peacock From Matthew Weiner In the coming-of-age project, Qamata will play the heroine, Princess Selani, while Murphy will star as the villain, Selani’s uncle Vakoro. There are also musical elements. Watch on Deadline The project marks comedy legend Murphy’s first animated movie outside of the Shrek franchise and Disney’s original Mulan from 1998. It’s also actress Bria Murphy’s feature screenwriting debut. Michael Xavier, Bria Murphy, Ray Murphy Jr., Autumn Bailey-Ford, and Chris Brew are producing. The team is currently out to directors and potential studio, streaming and production partners. Golden Globe, Emmy and Grammy winner Murphy most recently starred in Amazon action-comedy The Pickup . Shrek 5 releases next year. Bria Murphy has previously appeared in movies including 2024 reboot Beverly Hills Cop: Axel F and 2016 rom-com The Perfect Match . M’tali is the father and daughter’s second film collaboration. Murphy first shared a screen with one of his children in 2021 when his daughter Bella had a cameo in Coming 2 America . Qamata is best known for playing Puleng Khumalo in Netflix’s hit South African crime-drama series Blood & Water . Her credits also include Gomora , Fight Like A Girl and Commandos . “As a mother of a four-year-old son, I’m always looking for stories I can share with him that show a child what true strength looks like. M’tali does that. Selani leads with heart, curiosity and faith in her people, not with power. I’m proud to help bring a story rooted in African culture to the screen, with a family this talented behind it, and with Eddie Murphy leading the way,” said producer Autumn Bailey-Ford. Bailey-Ford is the founder and CEO of Autumn Bailey Entertainment, the production company with operations in Atlanta and Cape Town. Her credits include Color Book (Netflix), On a Wing and a Prayer (MGM/Amazon) and the upcoming Barbershop (Amazon, 202 7). articles.title: Pierce Brosnan & Helen Mirren Talk Toxic ‘MobLand’ Marriage, Murder, Madness & What’s Next
articles.full_text: Helen Mirren is brandishing an enormous, shiny carving knife. With a wicked little smile, she leans over her on-screen husband Pierce Brosnan , the blade hovering close to his throat. As her MobLand character Maeve Harrigan, she’s already (probably) been dropping antifreeze in her beloved hubby Conrad’s tea and, so far in the show, we’ve seen best friends bumped off, the couple’s eldest son chain-sawed to death and, in the Season 2 premiere , a full-on massacre at the dog track. This couple are, shall we say, complicated. Now, Mirren swoops in with her (actually fake) knife and rather un-murderously uses it to cut the (also fake) Sunday roast on the table. She and Brosnan are so in sync, such a perfectly dead-pan double act, that everyone in the room breaks into laughter. After all, it’s something special to be in the presence of acting royalty — Dame Mirren, who, among many epic roles, played Queen Elizabeth II in The Crown , and Pierce Brosnan, the actual former 007 . Related Stories News Dan Hicks Dies: Longtime Voice Of NBC Sports Was 64 Below The Line International Cinematographers Guild Marks 100 Years Of "Protecting Crafts, Livelihoods & Creative Voices" Mirren and Brosnan could have met on set some 46 years ago, only they never crossed paths while filming The Long Good Friday . In fact, they wouldn’t work together directly until The Thursday Murder Club , which premiered just last year, in which Mirren plays a retired MI6 agent and Brosnan a former union leader, solving crimes together in a retirement community. It was on that set that they got chatting about a script they’d both been sent about London gangsters, co-created by Guy Ritchie and Ronan Bennett , written by Jez Butterworth with Bennett and Esther Watson . “Do you like it?” Brosnan and Mirren asked each other. And that was it, they were in. Before the Season 1 shoot, the pair talked about their approach. They’d play it London mobster, with a South London-specific accent. But Ritchie had other ideas. About 20 minutes before the first shot, he told Brosnan, “Go Irish!” And Brosnan, being from Ireland, did just that. Then he called Mirren to break the news. That first season proved a massive hit for Paramount+ — one of its biggest original series debuts ever — with 26 million global viewers and 8.8 million in just the first week. WATCH: THE MOBLAND INTERVIEW WITH PIERCE BROSNAN AND HELEN MIRREN As Mirren and Brosnan sit together now post-shoot, there’s a continuous stream of storytelling and shared jokes between them, and something about the many mutual friends and much shared history between stage and screen brings a familial quality. It’s probably part of the reason we easily believe that Maeve and Conrad are forever bonded, despite, and probably because of their mutual depravity. Since Season 1 we’ve watched Maeve pour metaphorical poison in Conrad’s ear — sometimes he takes it on board, sometimes he doesn’t — while Conrad rules the roost, viciously stamping out anyone with even an imagined whiff of disloyalty. And top of his most-trusted list is Harry Da Souza (Tom Hardy), his ‘head of security’ — a title that seems to include everything from crime scene clean-up to keeping Conrad and Maeve’s psychotic grandson Eddie (Anson Boon) in check. Harry’s wife Jan (Joanne Froggatt) is none too fond of the Harrigans, but she’s stuck with them, because Harry is friends-for-life with Conrad and Maeve’s second son Kevin (Paddy Considine), whom he met in prison years back. As Season 1 rolled into Season 2 , the ante was upped again and again by Conrad’s quick temper and his emerging cognitive decline, alongside Maeve’s increasingly deranged scheming. Horrifying family secrets emerged, and even worse, vile Eddie started dating Harry’s chronically-moody teenage daughter Gina (Teddie Allen). Kevin made a (probably insane) move to take over the family, and Conrad is wondering if Maeve’s poison stash is meant for him or his illegitimate daughter Seraphina (Mandeep Dhillon). While the family holes up at their country estate in the Cotswolds, Harry’s keeping a foot in both camps, but Maeve is out for his blood, no matter what. Oh, and Jan tried to leave the whole mess behind and ended up getting catfished by a killer. But then luckily, she’s quite handy with a weapon herself… MobLand ’s Season 2 finale airs on Paramount + on November 20 th and with the show already renewed for Season 3, Brosnan and Mirren admit they’ve seen scripts for the first few Season 3 episodes. Will they tell us what’s coming? Probably not. But long may the MobLand chaos reign… DEADLINE: I went down a Reddit rabbit hole about this show. People are very, very invested. So, my first question to you both would be, what’s your take on whether these two are pure psychopaths or what drives them? What made them this way? HELEN MIRREN: We’ve talked a little bit about their backstory, haven’t we? Just between the two of us. It’s not something we particularly went into when we first started the project. When we first started, we just started, and just took every day as it came and didn’t really do much- PIERCE BROSNAN: In-depth investigation. We were shooting from the hip. MIRREN: Yes, absolutely. BROSNAN: Guy [Ritchie] gave us five scripts and we both said, “Do you like it?” And we both said yes and we jumped. MIRREN: Yes, we jumped. There was no time to have a really in-depth discussion. We didn’t have any rehearsal time or anything like that. BROSNAN: We still don’t. Pierce Brosnan as Conrad Harrigan and Helen Mirren as Maeve Harrigan In ‘MobLand’, Season 2. Luke Varley/Paramount+ MIRREN: But over time, Pierce and I have been talking a little bit about where we think this relationship started. And obviously, it started in Ireland and it logistically makes sense that it would’ve been during the time of The Troubles, so that also makes sense for their two characters. They’re creatures of their life, if you like. And I guess I don’t think they have psychopathic… Do you think they do? BROSNAN: I certainly don’t have it, no. MIRREN: What an insult. How dare you. BROSNAN: Just a lovely home in the Cotswolds, they’re a delightful family. They’re a little bit twisted here and there. MIRREN [deadpan to BROSNAN]: get rid of her because I’m very offended. [Laughs] DEADLINE: Well, there is the small matter of antifreeze poisoning and getting your son’s head chopped off with a chainsaw, but we’ll just gloss over that. BROSNAN: That’s what makes it compelling. Oh, she’s had it in for Harry ever since the beginning. I think she understands instinctively, the danger of Harry, the power of Harry… She’s not quite sure, if push came to shove, who would have final say. Helen Mirren MIRREN: Yes. And also, you don’t want to investigate these things too much. It’s not a modern psychopathic drama, it’s a Jacobean tragedy, a comedy-tragedy. And you don’t want to psychologically pull these things apart too much. It’s a sort of wonderful, mad ride. It’s like going on Magic Mountain in Disneyland. You pay your money and you take the ride. BROSNAN: Guy set the tone for it. His style of directing is, you go out, you rehearse it and you think, “Oh, that’s OK.” And he says, “OK, let’s shoot. Going in 5… going in 4.” And you shoot it. MIRREN: And bang, you’re in it. BROSNAN: You’re in it. And you might have flubbed a line, or you might have got something misplaced, but he keeps shooting, so you’re moving very fast. MIRREN: It’s a great energy. DEADLINE: Helen, in the past, you’ve said that you are lucky if you get two takes, that’s the pace this moves at. Does your stage experience feed into the way that you operate on this kind of a fast-moving set? MIRREN: I think absolutely. BROSNAN: I would say yes. We’re both from the stage. I mean, Dame Helen certainly has a wealth of stage experience. I was in quite a few good plays in the day. And this is the closest to going back to the theater for me, in the sense that you have broad scenes, rich scenes to play, you shoot them very fast. And you’re surrounded by brilliant actors. MIRREN: Great young actors. BROSNAN: So, it’s an ensemble. MIRREN: Who, with or without our personal background, they are all in it and up for it, aren’t they? I mean, maybe they’re following our guide, I don’t know, but there’s no messing around. BROSNAN: Everyone’s ready to go. Once the trap’s up, you’re in, go out there. And of course, the writing of Jez Butterworth, we always go back to that because his text is so rich and so nuanced. And like Helen says, it’s a Jacobian tragedy-comedy and there’s a wealth of humor in there to be had in the broad strokes. BROSNAN: So, it’s an ensemble. MIRREN: And a weird poetry. There is a poetry in there. BROSNAN: There is a lyrical, nuanced rhythm to his speech. MIRREN: Dark poetry. DEADLINE: I love that you mentioned Magic Mountain before, because I actually had ‘roller coaster’ written in my notes. Brosnan and Mirren in ‘MobLand’ Season 2. Luke Varley/Paramount+ MIRREN: It’s a roller coaster in the dark. DEADLINE: It’s really funny at times. Are there moments where you crack up on set? Because some of the lines you get to say are just such zingers. MIRREN: They are, they are. BROSNAN: You nailed them so brilliantly. MIRREN: So do you, Pierce. You really have a big emotional explosion so brilliantly. BROSNAN: Thank you, thank you. But I do love your tone of phrases as Maeve. DEADLINE: I liked your analogy about “the trap goes up” and everyone’s ready. It’s so pertinent because Season 2, Episode 1 at the dog track, that scene directed by Guy Ritchie is wild. Conrad’s on the back foot. I think the only thing that matters to him is whether Maeve respects him in that moment. Because she gives him a look of pride. BROSNAN: Yes. MIRREN: Yes, absolutely. We improvised. I improvised the line as we were leaving. They never used it because I think he didn’t want us exiting, but I improvised the line as we were walking out hand in hand. I said, “I f**king love you.” It’s like, “At last he’s back. My man, I’ve got my man.” Tom Hardy as Harry Da Souza and Paddy Considine as Kevin Harrigan in ‘MobLand’, season 2. Luke Varley/Paramount+ BROSNAN: Conrad needs Maeve. He needs Maeve and they both need each other. They’re joined at the hip in this kind of cataclysmic life of theirs. And Guy revels in it. I mean, that was a fabulous day. MIRREN: That was a great day, wasn’t it? So fun, it was fantastic. BROSNAN: We came back from lunch on that particular day and Guy said to Helen and I, “Well, I’m just going to stand over there. I want to show you what you’re going to do.” I was like, “OK.” We were standing there with all the lads, all the bad guys. And Guy came in and played Helen, and then he played me and started shooting everybody. He was blocking the scene for us. DEADLINE: How was he at playing you Helen? MIRREN: Well, it was a Bob the Builder version of Maeve. BROSNAN: He’s always there in his braces [suspenders]. Ga-da, ga-da, ga-da [shooting noises] He went all around the room, ga-da, ga-da, ga-da. MIRREN: He loved it. You could tell he was dying to be in it himself. DEADLINE: There was a recent event in London about the show, and there was some talk that somebody is going to challenge Harry in Season 3. Now, why do I think that might be Maeve? Because she just would love to see him dead. MIRREN: Oh, she’s had it in for Harry ever since the beginning. I think she understands instinctively, the danger of Harry, the power of Harry, and the danger of him. She’s not quite sure, if push came to shove, who would have final say, whether it be with Conrad or with the family in general. And I think although he’s unbelievably valuable to the family, sometimes you have to be aware of giving people too much power within your world. Do you know what I mean? Pierce Brosnan as Conrad Harrigan in ‘MobLand’ season 2. Luke Varley/Paramount+ BROSNAN: Oh, yeah. As Conrad, I know very much what you mean. MIRREN: They can take over. Anyway, we’ll see where that goes. We don’t know. It’s a great, fabulous adventure, the whole thing, so we absolutely have no idea where we’re going. BROSNAN: We have the first three episodes of the third season, which is 10 episodes. DEADLINE: Do you often get the script and go, “Will the bullet be between my eyes this time?” MIRREN: “Am I still alive at the end?” All the time. DEADLINE: What happens in Season 2 in Ireland with Eddie and Gina is such a Maeve-coded twisted mess. Do we think Conrad knows what really went on, or is he closing his eyes to it? BROSNAN: It’s six of one and a half a dozen of the other. And because his mental faculty is somewhat diminishing here, and I have no idea where Jez is going to take this road. And I haven’t asked him. I don’t want to know, really. But at the same time, there’s ways of playing it where you as the actor know, and you as Conrad know what’s going on around you. You have to be aware. It’s basically Maeve. As much as I love her, she is lethal. Helen Mirren as Maeve Harrigan in ‘MobLand’ Season 2. Luke Varley/Paramount+ DEADLINE: Could she ever do anything bad enough to break them up? MIRREN: Yes. I think there is a point at which Conrad would cut her off, cut her out. Although she’s done heinous things in and around the family, I don’t know, actually. I don’t know, I don’t really want to talk about that. BROSNAN: It’s best not to know. MIRREN: Yes, play it as it comes. BROSNAN: You really can’t turn the corner until you get there. DEADLINE: My thought when Conrad went to the neurologist and they said, “Your impulse control is depleted,” I thought, maybe it was always like this.” MIRREN: It’s so great to watch Pierce do those scenes. You know it’s coming, because obviously, you’ve read the script and you learned the lines and now we’re in the scene. And I love it when Pierce… It’s like watching this volcano erupt. It’s like Mount Etna erupting and you know it’s coming. I love sitting in that living room and thinking, oh, Pierce is going to erupt. It’s going to be so fantastic. And it always is. He just commands it, it’s fabulous to watch. Joanne Froggatt as Jan Da Souza and Tom Hardy as Harry Da Souza In ‘MobLand’ Season 2 Paramount+ DEADLINE : I listened to a podcast with you Helen where you talked about how sometimes, playing a character, you would go into it imagining they were drunk. Is that a factor with Maeve? MIRREN: Absolutely. And luckily she normally is drunk all the time. BROSNAN: Sauced. It’s a good one. MIRREN: It’s liberating. BROSNAN: Yeah, it is liberating if you feel like you’re tanked up as the character in that particular scene. It gives you a rhythm, and it gives you a kind of safe place to pick your way through the scene, as it were. MIRREN: Yes, it just opens up all kinds of possibilities. When you’re drunk, you don’t care about anything. The second season was tough because the scripts were coming in late and everyone was under the gun… but we get on really well. I mean, Helen and I were cast, and then it was always going to be, “Who’s playing Harry? Who’s it going to be?” When Tom Hardy came onto the stage, we couldn’t be happier. Pierce Brosnan BROSNAN: They’re animals. I mean, Conrad is an animal. He’s this kind of bull of a man who’s not quite in control. MIRREN: A bull or panther? BROSNAN: Panthers are very sleek. MIRREN: Yeah, maybe he’s more bull. But he’s a little more adroit than a bull. Although bulls in the ring are incredibly adroit, actually, when you watch them in a bullfight. They’re incredible. BROSNAN: They’re very nimble. Do you have an image for Maeve? When we were doing The Thursday Murder Club and you and I both said, “Well, let’s do this,” we were sitting there one morning, having a cup of tea. You were on your laptop and you said, “This is what I’m thinking about for Maeve.” And Helen opened up her laptop and there was this photograph of this Australian monster. MIRREN: A blonde lady, yes. BROSNAN: A blonde lady, yeah. With peroxide blonde, white hair. MIRREN: Yes, white hair. Nails black, all in black otherwise. BROSNAN: I remember thinking, “Oh my god, she’s got her character already. What am I going to do? What am I going to do?” Helen Mirren as Maeve Harrigan and Pierce Brosnan as Conrad Harrigan In ‘MobLand’, Season 2. Luke Varley/Paramount+ DEADLINE: I was going to ask you, actually, did either of you look at real-life criminals as some kind of inspiration, or even fictional criminals? BROSNAN: You did. MIRREN: I did, yes. A little bit. But the thing is to… It’s kind of useful, but really what you do is invent there and then on the spot, and allow, as Pierce said, allow the text to guide you, lead you, inspire you. That’s your jumping off of this, really, rather than some sort of theoretical study of the criminal mind. We’re not in that world. It’s not a documentary, docudrama, of any sort of… You’re in the world of imagination, a kind of excessive gothic world. And I think honestly, that’s the great entertainment of it. And it’s undoubtedly entertaining. BROSNAN: Absolutely, utterly, yes. And they’re compelling characters and everyone likes to play. Everyone likes to give performance. It is one of those shows where you can give a performance, play a performance. MIRREN: And how strong all the characters are as well. I love how strong all the women are. All the female characters have real agency, real energy, real complication. None of them are there just as a sort of cipher of any sort. And likewise, all the male characters. The chaps, Paul [Emmett J. Scanlan]’s character. Obviously, Anson’s character. They’re all such individual, interesting characters on their own. None of them are fillers at all. DEADLINE: Paul, he’s such a character, but he could have just been just some minor, lackey person, given a different writer. MIRREN: Yes. And I think he’s going to really appear more and more. BROSNAN: Absolutely. He’s loved, he’s adored. Top man. DEADLINE: When there were mutterings that Tom Hardy wouldn’t come back for Season 3 due to some rumored disagreements, both of you spoke up in support of him on social media. So, it’s obviously a close-knit cast? BROSNAN: Very much so. That was a real storm in a teacup. It really blindsided me when I read the reports. I thought, “What the heck is going on?” Because the second season was tough because the scripts were coming in late and everyone was under the gun. We had a first season which is really tight and wonderful and magnificent and fresh and new. It’s sometimes hard to really just keep it on track, but we get on really well. I mean, Helen and I were cast, and then it was always going to be, “Who’s playing Harry? Who’s it going to be?” When Tom Hardy came onto the stage, we couldn’t be happier. DEADLINE: It’s hard to imagine anyone else in that role. MIRREN: No, no, no. Absolutely not. DEADLINE: As Harry he has this stillness and it’s in great contrast to the chaos around him. Did you know he was going to play it like that? MIRREN: No, no. That is his incredible power. It’s spellbinding. I can’t think of the right way to put it, but backwards and coming forwards. The stillness of Tom, the power of Tom is fantastic. And it’s so great against Maeve, Conrad, Eddie, Seraphina, who are all such big, big, mad characters. DEADLINE: Looking forward, at the end of Season 2 and into Season 3, what’s it going to take to keep these two at top of the power dynamic in the family? Because it is a rocky situation right now. MIRREN: Well, money, I guess. BROSNAN: Money, love prevails. MIRREN: It’s not just money, is it? It’s power. BROSNAN: It’s power, the lust for power. And fear of dying. You don’t want to die. Mortality is circling the wagons here. And they know about death. MIRREN: They’re saying, “Down to death.” Read More About: Comments

articles.title: Patrick Hoerl’s Autentic Buys Gedeon Media Group’s Assets & Launches Studio
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Jesse Whittock Jesse Whittock International TV Co-Editor @WhittockTweets More Stories By Jesse Jeff Goldblum To Narrate Cliburn Piano Competition Doc Series ‘Exit Stage Right’ ‘Line Of Duty’: Arnott, Fleming & Hastings Return To Service In First Look At Season 7 Of BBC’s Record-Setting Cop Drama Gang Dong-won & Kim Go-eun To Lead Netflix Korea Romance-Action Period Drama ‘The Twilight Between Us’ From Kim Won-suk View All November 12, 2026 8:59am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Patrick Hoerl Autentic Patrick Hoerl’s German factual specialist Autentic has acquired the assets of Gedeon Media Group (GMG), and is launching a studios business off the back of the deal. GMG was forced into judicial liquidation earlier this year by a French Commercial Court after running into financial difficulties, with Autentic among those expressing interests in a rescue deal. Autentic has now won out. The Munich-based has now established Gedeon Studios as a French production and distribution subsidiary, with GMG’s 3,000-hour catalog being subsumed into Autentic Distribution and a digital channels division going into Autentic’s channel management unit. Related Stories Executives Tubi CEO Anjali Sud, Roku Media President Charlie Collier Leaving The Fold As Fox Sets Exec Team After Roku Close News Good News Network Sold To Group Including Whalar Co-Founder James Street The asset deal includes Gedeon Programmes, Docland Yard and MC4. Gedeon filed was placed in liquidation in August, with the program units allowed to continue trading while a buyer was sought and sales arm Terranoa shuttered immediately. Watch on Deadline Gedeon Studios will oversee all ongoing GMG productions and project development, including approximately 25 hours of television programming currently in production and two feature-length documentaries. A seven-member team from the existing organization will join the new business. This includes senior producers Laurence Favreau, Valérie Guerin and Coraline Roch and Head of Development Mina Cuche. Carine Nonnenmacher, one of GMG’s senior producers, will lead the new studio, with GMG’s founder and former President, Stéphane Millière, working closely with the new company as Senior Consultant, Programme Development. Gedeon was founded back in 1996 with the creation of Gedeon Programmes, and went on to become one of France’s most well-known factual production companies and the winner of more than 500 international awards for its docs in genres such as science, archaeology, history, culture and heritage. The likes of the BBC, CCTV, National Geographic, PBS, NHK, RADIO Canada, RAI, RTS, RTVE, SBS, SVT and ZDF have all counted themselves as buyers. Autentic has a similar reputation in Germany, well established in factual genre. “With Gedeon Studios in Paris and Autentic in Munich, we will have teams in the two biggest markets in Europe,” said Patrick Hoerl, Managing Director at Autentic. “By combining the expertise of both companies, and using significant synergies in the monetization of content, will make us more resilient in the current, challenging market environment. “Over more than three decades, Stéphane Millière and the Gedeon team have built an extraordinary legacy, establishing the company as one of the most respected names in factual production. We are proud to continue that journey together with the team in France, preserving valuable expertise and creative excellence while laying the foundation for the next phase of growth.” Millière added he was “very pleased that Autentic is taking over the assets of the Gedeon Group through a new company that will continue to build on the work of the outstanding editorial team that has worked alongside me to develop the brand, carry forward ongoing projects and distribute the catalogue established over the past 30 years.” “This alliance between two strong brands and two talented teams further strengthens the potential of Autentic for the years to come. I have the greatest respect for Patrick Hoerl, who has always been a passionate advocate for the documentary genre. I am delighted that he will become President of this new Gedeon.” Jensen Huang Is Out As Nvidia CEO Amid Affair Scandal; Successor Sought Eddie Murphy & Ama Qamata Voicing Animated Fantasy Movie ‘M’Tali’ ‘Focker-In-Law’ Premiere Pics: Grande, De Niro, Feldstein & More Breton Replaced As Federation Studios Prez; Montefiore Ups Stake Read More About: Comments

articles.title: Paramount+ Greenlights Damian Lewis-Starring Premier League Comedy Series ‘Day 1s’ From Matthew Vaughn, Cristiano Ronaldo & Thierry Henry
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Max Goldbart Max Goldbart International TV Co-Editor @Goldbart1 More Stories By Max BBC Boss Matt Brittin & Industry Leaders Set To Attend Culture Secretary’s Emergency Meeting Next Week Following Brand & Walliams Scandals Barbara Broccoli Appointed President Of UK’s National Film & Television School Lionel Uzan Succeeding Pascal Breton As President Of Federation Studios; Montefiore Ups Stake View All November 12, 2026 9:00am Add us as a Google Preferred Source L to R: Cristiano Ronaldo, Damian Lewis, Matthew Vaughn, Thierry Henry Ian Gavan/Getty, Steve Gullick, Ilya S. Savenok/Getty, Courtesy Thierry Henry A sports comedy series combining the unlikely foursome of Damian Lewis , Cristiano Ronaldo , Matthew Vaughn and Thierry Henry has found a home at Paramount+ . In one of its first big greenlights since the Skydance merger, the streamer has made a straight-to-series order for Day 1s , which tells of a young soccer player playing for Brentford FC in the UK’s Premier League. Day 1s is the first TV project from Ronaldo and Kingsman director Vaughn’s UR-Marv Studios and counts another soccer superstar, Henry, amongst its EPs. Producer Darren Dein conceived of the idea, Vaughn has directed the pilot and BAFTA-winner Dan Mazer ( Borat ) is set to showrun. Related Stories News Pierce Brosnan & Helen Mirren Talk Toxic 'MobLand' Marriage, Murder, Madness & What's Next News Sterling K. Brown To Narrate 'The Elite: Army Rangers' Docuseries For Paramount+ While in development, the show was reported to be about a soccer agent but the 10-parter in fact follows a gifted young player who achieves his dream of playing in the Premier League, bringing along his friends who stood by him long before the money, fame and success – his Day 1s. Watch on Deadline The project was the first TV show set at UR-Marv but it’s been a busy week for Ronaldo and Vaughn. We revealed late last week that their irreverent action-comedy Stuntnuts starring Chris Hemsworth and Sam Rockwell would be heading to the American Film Market. Alongside UR-Marv, producers on Day 1s are Dein’s DoubleD Sports and Kris Thykier ’s Archery Pictures . Day 1s is one of the first big bets placed by the new Paramount+ regime since the Skydance merger. Vaughn thanked the likes of Casey Bloys, Sarah Aubrey and Amy Gravitt for taking a chance on Day 1s. “It’s the perfect project for Cristiano and I to start our company with – and to say he is a friend and a partner is a true honour,” he added. “I’m sure the man who has broken every record in football will soon be doing the same in film and TV.” Ronaldo said: “I’ve spent my entire life in football, and I know that some of the most powerful stories happen away from the pitch. Football is about dreams, ambition, loyalty, sacrifice and the people who believe in you from day one. That’s what makes Day 1s special. As a producer, I’m proud to help bring a different side of the game to life, through a story that I believe can connect with audiences far beyond football. To take this first journey in the industry alongside my partner and friend Matthew Vaughn and having a superb former player and a great person like Thierry Henry on board makes this all even more special.” The series will be executive produced by Vaughn, Dein, Ronaldo, Henry and Lewis, along with Doug Ellin, Mazer and Thykier ( Hijack ). Vaughn is repped by WME and Johnson Shapiro Slewett & Kole; Henry is repped by DoubleD Sports; Mazer is repped by CAA, LBI Entertainment and Davis Law Group; Thykier is repped by Del Shaw Moonves Tanaka Finkelstein Lezcano Bobb & Dang; and Lewis is repped by Markham, Froggatt & Irwin and Range Media Partners. articles.title: Lucasfilm Sets ‘Star Wars: A New Hope’ IMAX 70mm Re-Release & New Behind-The-Scenes Doc ‘The Hero Awakens’ For 50th Anniversary Celebrations
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Zac Ntim Zac Ntim International Reporter @ZacharyNtim More Stories By Zac Eddie Murphy & Ama Qamata Voicing Animated Fantasy Movie ‘M’Tali: The Everlasting Spring’ ‘Soul Patrol’: J.M. Harper On Exploring The Complex Legacy Of The First All-Black U.S. Special Ops Team In Vietnam Ryūsuke Hamaguchi’s ‘All Of A Sudden’ To Open AFI Silver’s 2026 European Union Film Showcase — Full Lineup View All November 12, 2026 9:01am Add us as a Google Preferred Source From left: Mark Hamill, Carrie Fisher and Harrison Ford in 'Star Wars' aka 'Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope' (1977) Everett Lucasfilm and Disney have restored the original Star Wars (1977) and will release the film in multiple formats, including IMAX 70mm, as part of the franchise’s 50th anniversary celebrations. The re-release is among several events Lucasfilm and Disney announced this afternoon for next year’s anniversary celebrations. Screenings of the original 1977 version of Star Wars will begin on February 19. In addition to the IMAX 70mm screenings, the film will also be presented in Digital IMAX, Digital Cinema, 70mm, 35mm, and 4DX. Related Stories News 'Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope' To Play At Cosm As Disney Teams With Shared Reality Firm News Adam Driver Says No More Kylo Ren: 'Star Wars' "Ship Has Sailed" On May 4th, 2027, Lucasfilm will release a new behind-the-scenes documentary, The Hero Awakens , from filmmaker R.J. Cutler on Disney+. The film is said to detail the making of Star Wars . The company’s synopsis reads: “This film will be a unique treat for fans as it exclusively features archival footage and audio captured during and around the making of the historic film in 1977.” The Hero Awakens is produced by Lucasfilm, Cutler and This Machine, and Kennedy/Marshall. Watch on Deadline 2027 Star Wars events already on the calendar include Shawn Levy’s Star Wars : Starfighter , which will be released on May 28. Season 2 of Ahsoka will premiere January 20, 2027. Star Wars Celebration will take place on April 1-4 in Los Angeles. “It is incredibly special to mark the 50th anniversary by returning the original version of Star Wars to theaters so audiences can experience this part of film history on the big screen,” Lucasfilm Co-President Lynwen Brennan said in a statement. “We look forward to celebrating with our fans all year long—from the releases of ‘Ahsoka’ and ‘ Star Wars: Starfighter’ to exclusive merchandise, new publishing stories, unforgettable experiences and interactive games. articles.title: Sophie Nélisse Gives ‘Heated Rivalry’ Season 2 Update: “I Actually Just Wrapped”
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Glenn Garner Glenn Garner Associate Editor @xoxo_glenn More Stories By Glenn PGA Create Lab Announces 2026 Fellows Elijah Wood Says “Muscle Memory” Kicked In Playing Frodo On ‘The Hunt For Gollum’ Set ‘VisionQuest’ Teases Surprise ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Character Return In Post-Credits Scene View All November 12, 2026 9:01am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Sophie Nélisse attends Paramount+'s 'Yellowjackets' Season 4 premiere on Nov. 11, 2026 in Los Angeles, California. Katie Flores/PMC With two seasons and a movie on deck, Sophie Nélisse has wrapped on her Heated Rivalry movie star character. The actress, who plays Rose Landry on the Crave / HBO Max series, told Deadline that she finished filming her scenes for Season 2 just two days before walking the red carpet for Yellowjackets ‘ final season, premiering Nov. 20 on Paramount+ with Premium Plan. “We have started filming Season 2,” Nélisse noted. “I actually just wrapped the day before yesterday, I wrapped two days ago.” Related Stories News What To Expect For ‘Heated Rivalry’ Season 2: Everything We Know So Far Trailers ‘Yellowjackets’ Trailer: The Team Adjusts To Civilization With Creepy Alanis Morissette Soundtrack In Final Season The update came after Deadline revealed that, following the show’s Season 2 renewal , series creator Jacob Tierney is filming two seasons and a Christmas movie , back-to-back. Watch on Deadline With the immense success of the show, based on Rachel Reid’s Game Changer novels, Heated Rivalry has received critical acclaim and became HBO Max’s top acquired scripted series ever with more than 10.6 million US viewers in two months. Nélisse feels “really grateful” to be apart of that story, given its impact on LGBTQ audiences. Sophie Nélisse on filming ‘Heated Rivalry’ Season 2 and seeing how much viewers have been impacted by and resonate with the series pic.twitter.com/2Dhb2WcnNP — Deadline (@DEADLINE) November 12, 2026 “I don’t think none of us could have predicted this kind of success, but I couldn’t be happier because it’s one of those projects that people were in it truly for the right reasons,” she explained. “And they poured all their hearts and souls into it because they truly believed in the story, in the craft, in Jacob’s vision. “And there’s just this genuineness on set, and I think that that really transpired on screen. And I think that’s why it’s knowing the success that it’s knowing, because the connections are real between every character. And because it’s a story that I think needed to be told for so long.” Nélisse continued, “Yes, I’m so happy for Hudson [Williams] and Connor [Storrie], but also, it feels really special to be part of a show that resonates so well with people on such a deep level. Seeing testimonies of people coming out or finally being able to talk about a story that they’ve never been able to voice before, it feels like the work that you’re doing actually has a real impact. And I think that’s something that I feel really grateful to be a part of.” Sophie Nélisse as Rose Landry and Hudson Williams as Shane Hollander in ‘Heated Rivalry’ With Rachel Reid’s Game Changer novel The Long Game serving as the basis for Season 2 of Heated Rivalry , production began on the sophomore season of Tierney’s Crave Original series adaptation in Canada in August. Deadline previously reported that Justice Smith, Charlie Gillespie, Daniel Diemer, Shaheen Jafargholi, Emily Hampshire, Edvin Ryding, Robert Naylor, Sabrina Jalees, Priyanka, Brendan Morgan, David Tomlinson, Gerry Dee, Michelle Mylett, Lauren Chan and Nick Stahl have been cast in Season 2 , which is set to premiere in spring 2027.
