Rowling “At All,” Insists He’s “Super Clear” About Trans Support View All November 10, 2026 6:50pm Add us as a Google Preferred Source Shay Mitchell, Troian Bellisario, Lucy Hale and Ashley Benson in 'Pretty Little Liars' Ron Tom/ABC Family/Courtesy Everett Collection Nearly a decade later, the cast of Pretty Little Liars is apparently ready to take another secret to the grave. Lucy Hale , who starred as Aria Montgomery on the Freeform series, recently teased that everyone from the cast is “willing and would want to” reprise their roles for a revival of the teen mystery series based on Sara Shepard’s YA novels. “I don’t think it would take much. I think everyone is willing and would want to,” she told Entertainment Tonight . “I think it’s just a matter of schedule and getting the right script. I think the script has to be right, the storyline has to be right.” Related Stories Cancellations and Renewals ‘Pretty Little Liars: Summer School’ Canceled After Two Seasons On Max Agencies ‘Pretty Little Liars’ Author Sara Shepard Signs With Gersh Hale continued, “And where is Aria? What’s Aria doing? Especially all the girls that came out of Rosewood, I feel like they’re not ever able to escape it. So, I feel like they somehow maybe left town but found their way back.” Watch on Deadline After the show’s 2017 series finale, which saw her character Aria end up with Ezra Fitz ( Ian Harding ), Hale predicted where they would be in the revival. “I do believe Aria and Ezra are still together. I believe they have kids. I believe Aria has written some books,” she said. Lucy Hale and Ian Harding are hand-delivering a message from 'A' — the entire 'Pretty Little Liars' cast is down for a return to Rosewood. 🖤 The former PLL couple is sharing what they think Aria and Ezra are up to now, while dishing on their on-screen reunion in 'The 12 Dates… pic.twitter.com/bjMly9L6vZ — Entertainment Tonight (@etnow) November 10, 2026 Harding, who reunites with Hale in Hulu’s The 12 Dates of Christmas , said that he’d want a revival to see everyone “in a place that is kind of what they wanted but maybe not quite, and then something brings them all back together.” Hale agreed, adding, “Like, a tragedy brings them all back to Rosewood or something. There’s gotta be a new version of ‘A’ as well.” The pair starred in the series alongside Shay Mitchell, Ashley Benson, Troian Bellisario, Sasha Pieterse, Keegan Allen, Tyler Blackburn and Janel Parrish. Following Pretty Little Liars ‘ seven-season run from 2010 to 2017, Freeform released the spin-off Pretty Little Liars: The Perfectionists for one season in 2019, followed by HBO Max’s offshoot Pretty Little Liars: Original Sin in 2022, which had ended in ’24 with Season 2, entitled Pretty Little Liars: Summer School . articles.title: ‘Dancing With The Stars’ Recap: Dance Offs On Grammy Night Bring Tough Competition To Quarterfinals
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Katie Campione Katie Campione Senior TV & Labor Reporter @katie_campione More Stories By Katherine ‘Dancing With The Stars’ Recap: Dance Offs On Grammy Night Bring Tough Competition To Quarterfinals How Film Producer Scott Budnick & Celebrity Barber VicBlends Teamed For A New Training Program In California Prisons ‘The Gilded Age’ Season 4 Debuts To Series’ Best Premiere Audience Yet View All November 10, 2026 7:00pm Add us as a Google Preferred Source 'Dancing With The Stars' SPOILER ALERT! This post contains details from the Season 35 Dancing with the Stars quarterfinals. It’s hard to believe Dancing with the Stars Season 35 is nearly over, but we’ve officially reached the quarterfinals. There are seven couples remaining, but only five can make it all the way to the finale later this month. One couple is facing elimination on Grammy night, where the contestants will be performing to some of the biggest hits in music from artists including Evanescence, Sisqó, Beyoncé, Janet Jackson and more. Related Stories News Luke Bryan, Megan Moroney & Vince Gill Among Performers Added To CMA Awards News Former 'DWTS' Contestant Danielle Fishel Says Judges Tougher On Female Contestants: "Men Get A Pass" For the second week in a row, the couples are performing a second dance on Tuesday night. This week, they’re going toe-to-toe for the dance off, which pits two couples directly against each other to a live accompaniment. The pairings are as follows: Amber vs. Ezra, Jenna vs. Tatyana and Connor vs. Maura. Watch on Deadline After earning immunity with the highest cumulative score to-date last week, Harry and Jenna will sit out of the dance off. Sheryl Crow, Brandy and Monica, and Maren Morris will join the stage to perform some of their hit songs for the head-to-head competition. Let’s get into it. INDIVIDUAL DANCES Paralympian Ezra Frech with Daniella Karagach . These two were in a flow state last week, and after earning a 10 from Derek for their Disney Night performance, they’re taking on an Argentine tango to “Crazy in Love (Remix)” by Beyoncé for Grammy Night. SCORE: 27 out of 30 Olympian Amber Glenn with Pasha Pashkov . As if she hasn’t already, Amber says she really wants to show off her inner athlete on the ballroom floor this week with a paso doble to to “Bring Me to Life” by Evanescence. SCORE: 28 out of 30 Reality star Maura Higgins with Mark Ballas . After barely escaping elimination last week, Maura is putting all her focus into an Argentine tango to “Thong Song” by Sisqó. She’s working through some pain in her rib, so that’s proving to be a challenge in rehearsals, but she pushes the pain aside and delivers a performance that Carrie Ann calls “a work of art.” SCORE: 27 out of 30 Actress Jenna Dewan with Val Chmerkovskiy . She got a perfect score last week, so Jenna is riding high and ready to take on a jazz routine to “All For You” by Janet Jackson. She previously performed at the Grammys, so she’s also got to stake her claim when walking on the floor Tuesday night. SCORE: Actress Tatyana Ali with Jan Ravnik . This Fresh Prince star has been friends with Will.I.Am for more than two decades, so she much do justice to a tango to “Boom Boom Pow” by Black Eyed Peas. She’s got to nail the sharpness of this choreography in order to wow the judges. SCORE: Comedian and podcaster Connor Wood with Rylee Arnold . Based on the comments from the judges last week, he’s got to take the lead if he wants to impress them tonight with an Argentine tango to “SexyBack” by Justin Timberlake featuring Timbaland. Now, if only he could stay on his axis point, as Carrie Ann points out. SCORE: 27 out of 30 Actor Harry Shum Jr. with Jenna Johnson . Harry says he’s avoiding doing salsa dancing for so long because it reminds him of a hard time in his childhood, so dancing a salsa to “Die with A Smile” by Lady Gaga and Bruno Mars is bringing up a lot of emotions for him. SCORE: 29 out of 30 DANCE OFF Amber Glenn and Pasha Pashkov vs. Ezra Frech and Daniella Karagach competed in a Rumba to “The Boy Is Mine” by Brandy and Monica. WINNER: Amber & Pasha (+2 bonus points) Jenna Dewan and Val Chmerkovskiy vs. Tatyana Ali and Jan Ravnik faced off in a Cha-Cha to “The Middle” by Zedd, Maren Morris and Grey. WINNER: Jenna and Val (+2 bonus points) Connor Wood and Rylee Arnold vs. Maura Higgins and Mark Ballas . will compete in a Cha-Cha to “All I Wanna Do” by Sheryl Crow. WINNER: Maura and Mark (+2 bonus points) Who goes home? After a night of tough competition, Jenna and Val are sent home. Next week is the semifinals. articles.title: ITV Cutting $40M From Media & Entertainment Budget Due To Weak Advertising Market
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Max Goldbart Max Goldbart International TV Co-Editor @Goldbart1 More Stories By Max How The ‘Married At First Sight UK’ Scandal Has Impacted Hit Show Around The World Jonathan Ross Explains Backstory Behind “Tasteless” David Walliams Joke ITV Cutting $40M From Media & Entertainment Budget Due To Weak Advertising Market View All November 11, 2026 12:59am Add us as a Google Preferred Source 'Love Island's Maya Jama ITV2 With “weaker demand for advertising” in Q4, ITV has identified £30M ($40M) worth of cost savings from its networks division, which will soon be sold to Sky . Total Advertising Revenue is set to drop 5-10% in Q4 and 2-3% for full year 2026, ITV said today in its Q3 trading update. The network is therefore finding savings from its Media & Entertainment biz, which houses the ITV network and streamer ITVX, “to align our costs with advertiser demand.” ITV said £25M will come from content savings and another £5M from “discretionary non-content savings,” with the total content budget for 2026 now expected to be around £1.2B. Related Stories News 'Britain's Got Talent' Producer Urges "Anyone Who Feels They Have Been Subject Of Wrongdoing" To Come Forward Following David Walliams Allegations News ITV News & Guardian Closer To Publishing Sexual Misconduct Allegations About British Star After Injunction Appeal Deadline Passed ITV boss Carolyn McCall put the sticky ad market down to “continuing broader macroeconomic uncertainty, increased digital advertising on global streaming platforms and the impact of Less Healthy Food regulations, which came into effect on 1 October 2025.” Watch on Deadline ITV revealed a similar saving target last year due to a “softening economy” in the UK. The news comes as Comcast-owned Sky pushes on with its £1.6B acquisition of ITV, although as revealed last week the UK Culture Secretary has now officially tasked two UK regulators with probing the deal. The Love Island network is bullish that it will make it through the probe unscathed. “This is an expected and important milestone in the regulatory review process, and we are pleased that it is moving at pace,” said McCall. “We continue to expect completion in the second half of 2027.” The news was revealed today in ITV’s Q3 results, which showed total revenue of £2.7B, almost flat with the same figure for the first nine months of 2025. Media & Entertainment revenue was also virtually flat at £1.4B, with digital revenue helping offset the advertising declines. Producer-distributor ITV Studios , which is not being sold to Sky, also posted stable revenue of around £1.3B. Within ITV Studios, ITV said revenue, margin and profit are “heavily weighted to Q4,” pointing to a “strong pipeline of deliveries” like Netflix Italy’s SuburraMaxima, Peacock’s Love Island US: Beyond the Villa and the seventh season of Line of Duty for the BBC, alongside “significant high-margin licensing deals” in the global partnerships division. McCall said the sale of ITV network to Sky will “position ITV Studios as a highly attractive, pure play, global content business.” As previously guided, ITV Studios’ EBITA margin will be at the lower end of the 13% to 15% range, reflecting the revenue mix in the year, ITV said. Elsewhere, streaming hours to ITVX shot up by 29% to more than 2 billion minutes viewed. “Despite a more challenging market, we remain on track to deliver good revenue growth in ITV Studios and continued profitable digital revenue growth in Media & Entertainment (M&E) over the full year,” said McCall. “While the outlook for advertising remains muted, we are firmly focused on self help and mitigating actions, while continuing to execute our strategic priorities to drive performance across both businesses.” Sarandos Faces Unrest From Past & Present Execs Over Netflix’s Direction ‘Mike Hammer’ Star, Film & Stage Actor, Dies At 85; Career In Photos Jason Orley Directing New Take On Rom-Com ‘You’ve Got Mail’ For Warner Bros Leah McKendrick Sets ‘Voicemails From Isabelle’ Follow-Up; Maddie Ziegler Stars Read More About: Comments

articles.title: ‘NAZA’ Becomes One Of The Most Watched Docs On Theatrical Release In 2026
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Melanie Goodfellow Melanie Goodfellow Senior International Film Correspondent @mel_goodfellow More Stories By Melanie ‘NAZA’ Becomes One Of The Most Watched Docs On Theatrical Release In 2026 Tyler Gallant To Star In Caravaggio Art Heist Drama ‘Nativity’ Buyers Dig Beta Cinema’s Norwegian Oscar Entry ‘Growth Of The Soil’ View All November 11, 2026 1:00am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Filmmaker Yuval Abraham (right) interviews a source in 'NAZA' The Guardian/JW Films Bombshell Gaza documentary NAZA by Israeli film-makers Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor is on track to become one of the most-watched documentary films on theatrical release of 2026. New figures, collated by producers The Guardian and JW Films, reveal that the film had been seen by a world-wide audience of 1,547,033 across 47 territories by November 6. With $13.5 million in international gross, excluding the U.S. where it has grossed more than $1 million, it ranks among the best-performing documentaries internationally of 2026 to date. Related Stories News Avi Nesher's Israeli Box Office Hit 'Our Loves' Brings Its Characters "To The Brink" But Is Not An "October 7 Movie" News Asian World Film Festival Reveals Asian Vision & Focus On Sections Based on interviews with 24 Israeli intelligence officers and soldiers, the documentary exposes the AI, phone surveillance and points-based systems deployed by the Israeli military in Gaza to identify targets, Hamas-related or otherwise, and then kill them in their homes regardless of whether other family members are likely to die in the strike as well. Watch on Deadline The documentary has performed best in Italy, where it was released by I Wonder on September 29 shortly after its Venice world premiere. The doc has reached 717.517 admissions there to date, with the film still playing in 379 cinemas, making history as the third most-watched documentary of all time in Italian cinemas, behind only Fahrenheit 9/11 and The March of the Penguins . Having started as a self-release through Michael Tuckman’s mTuckman Media in the U.S., Neon signed on as U.S. distributor in late October, aiming to enlarge the film’s footprint by building on the successful initial theatrical launch. To date the doc has clocked 83,673 admissions across the U.S. and Canada since its release on September 30. In the UK and Ireland, Dogwoof released NAZA on October 15 with a special live event screening at the Ritz in London, featuring directors Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, alongside producer Jim Wilson and exec producer Jonathan Glazer. The Q&A was broadcast live to a further 104 cinemas across the UK and Ireland. The release received strong support from the entire Picturehouse circuit, as well as venues from the three major multiplex chains (Odeon, Cineworld and Vue) alongside several independent cinemas. The live event alone attracted more than 7,000 admissions, with NAZA since climbing to 102.509 to date. In France, during a 48-hour event release due to French rules for films to be streamed online, NAZA attracted an audience of over 82,000 admissions. The film screened in more than 260 theaters nationwide, with nearly 500 screenings over two days. It topped the box office on both days, making it one of the most-watched documentaries in French theaters in 2026. The doc’s German distributor ImmerGuteFilme Germany has reported 83.355 admissions in the territory to date, with its strongest day to date on Sunday, November 1. In Austria , it has drawn 16.521 spectators, with Polyfilm releasing on October 1. In both countries, NAZA is outperforming Abraham and Szor’s Oscar-winning documentary No Other Land and Kaouther Ben Hania’s Oscar-nominated feature The Voice of Hind Rajab at the same stage. There was also a strong turnout in Spain, where Elastica released on October 9 on 105 screens, reaching 61.783 visitors by last Friday. Smaller countries are also reflecting the huge public interest in NAZA . Benelux distributor Cherry Pickers counted 132.323 admissions, a level of interest echoed by the over 50.000 visitors in Switzerland. The release said there are similar stories in other territories such as Australia / New Zealand, Scandinavia, Indonesia or Romania, Thailand, Poland, Mexico and Japan. The theatrical success follows the film’s high-profile premiere in Venice in September where it received a 25-minute ovation and won the Special Jury Prize. It has since won the Audience Award in San Sebastián and the Critics Prize at the Hot Springs Documentary Film Festival. At the New York Critics Circle Awards on November 8, it won Best Political Documentary, having also been nominated for Best Documentary Feature and Best Directors. NAZA is nominated as Best Documentary Feature for the Gotham Film Awards and included in both the DOC NYC shortlist and the shortlist for Best European Documentary at the European Film Awards. articles.title: India’s Yellowstone International Film Festival Announces Documentary And LGBTQIA+ Slates
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Matthew Carey Matthew Carey Documentary Editor, Awards @mattcarey More Stories By Matthew Lightdox Acquires Sales Rights To IDFA World Premiere ‘The Big Boom!’, Gabriel Tejedor Film With Explosive Contradictions India’s Yellowstone International Film Festival Announces Documentary And LGBTQIA+ Slates Oscar Winner David Dinerstein Boards ‘Room Of The Absolute’ As EP; Award-Winning Doc Creates Portrait Of Ukrainian Artist Alla Hurenko View All November 11, 2026 1:02am Add us as a Google Preferred Source YIFF EXCLUSIVE: The upcoming Yellowstone International Film Festival in Mumbai, India has announced its documentary lineup, highlighted by the Asian premiere of Oscar contender American Doctor . Director Poh Si Teng’s film examines three U.S. physicians who volunteered their medical expertise to treat Palestinian children severely injured in Israel’s sustained attack on Gaza (it screens Thursday at DOC NYC after being named to that festival’s prestigious shortlist). Joining American Doctor at the Yellowstone festival will be fellow documentary feature Herland , directed by Kallol Mukherjee, also making its Asian premiere. “In a deeply conservative Indian village where women are forbidden from stepping outside without male permission, Bhagyashree and her growing sisterhood rise in defiance, claiming their right to work and confronting generations of patriarchal control,” reads a description. “As their resistance gathers force, the cost of being seen as equal begins to turn dangerous. How much are they willing to risk?” Related Stories News Watermelon Pictures Co-Founders Talk Future Plans & Growing Hollywood Support For Palestinian Stories: "We've Been Seeing A Renaissance With A Lot Of The A-Listers" Documentary Inaugural West Hollywood Human Rights Film Festival To Showcase Oscar-Contending Documentaries, 20th Anniversary Screening Of 'Blood Diamond' YIFF Documentary feature The Wolf , directed by Wancheng Gu and Prasad Shetty, “follows Yuan, a 60-year-old queer former village mayor in Shanghai, as she navigates love, family obligations, and shifting economic landscapes while seeking autonomy and reinvention later in life.” Watch on Deadline The Yellowstone International Film Festival runs from November 30 to December 4 in Mumbai, capital of the Indian state of Maharashtra. Among the short documentaries programmed in the festival is Born Secret , directed by Riley Fitchpatrick, in which the filmmaker “returns to his hometown that built the atomic bomb . ” Scroll for the list of doc shorts in the lineup. YIFF YIFF also revealed its slate of LGBTQIA+-themed films. In addition to documentary The Wolf , features include Elephants in the Fog , winner of the Jury Prize in the Un Certain Regard section of the 2026 Cannes Film Festival. The film directed by Abinash Bikram Shah “follows Pirati, matriarch of a Kinnar (Trans) community in a Nepalese village, who dreams of escaping to a normal life. When one of her daughters disappears, she must investigate and choose between love and responsibility.” Tank Time (LGBTQIA Short) – A lonely, nonbinary teen finds courage, friendship, and a glimmer of magic in a stolen fish, a petty neighborhood feud, and an unexpected crush. Filmmaker – Jess Burgess; Country – United States; Runtime -16:39 The Witch of Vihar Lake (LGBTQIA Short) Mitthu, a timid young boy and his teenage sister Ishita live in a village close to Vihar Lake, where stories of a terrifying witch prevail. The village locals don’t dare go close to the forest or the haunted lake. Mystery and magic surround the siblings as they grapple with their parents’ ignorance and anger. We follow a bewitched Ishita and Mitthu in their coming-of-age journey as the threat of the witch looms over their lives. Filmmaker – Joey Kaushik; Country – India; Runtime – 10:47 The Sailor & The Chef – ( LGBTQIA+ Doc Short) Piyush & Sushil met entirely by chance 30 years ago at a theatre in Mumbai, India. Unbeknownst to each other, they were both gay & seeking partners in a time when the internet was nascent, and there was barely any out & proud queer community. Filmmaker- Ashish Sawhny; Country – India; Runtime -20:23 At this year’s festival, YIFF launches the inaugural KSF Queer Grant, in association with the Keshav Suri Foundation (KSF) and Lotus Visual Productions, committing $20,000 USD “towards the production of independent films by emerging LGBTQIA+ filmmakers in India. The initiative will select two filmmakers, each receiving $10,000 USD in production funding, alongside a nine-month program of industry mentorship and end-to-end creative and production support.” The grant has been established with a three-year commitment to ensure the long-term sustainability and impact of the initiative, YIFF notes. “Over the course of these three years, the collaborating organizations aim to support six filmmakers in producing six films, providing emerging queer storytellers with the resources and opportunities to bring their stories to life and share them with the world.” Tushar Tyagi, founder of Yellowstone International Film Festival YIFF Yellowstone International Film Festival founder Tushar Tyagi said, “Talent and compelling stories exist everywhere, but the opportunity to bring them to life is not always accessible to everyone. For many queer filmmakers in India, the challenge is not a lack of imagination or stories to tell, but access to the resources, industry networks and support needed to turn their creative vision into a film. Through this grant, we want to help bridge that gap by giving filmmakers the freedom and means to tell their stories with honesty and authenticity.” Tyagi continued, “Our ambition is to nurture a new generation of queer Indian voices, bring narratives rooted in lived experiences to the screen, and create opportunities for these stories to travel beyond borders. These stories deserve not only to be told, but to be seen, heard and celebrated by audiences around the world.” Keshav Suri, founder of the Keshav Suri Foundation YIFF Keshav Suri, founder of the Keshav Suri Foundation, commented, “Representation in cinema must go beyond having LGBTQIA+ characters on screen. It is equally important that people from the community have the resources and creative freedom to tell their own stories. There is no shortage of talent or compelling stories within the community, but access to funding and industry opportunities remains a challenge. Through this grant, we want to help bridge that gap and give more queer filmmakers the opportunity to bring their stories to life.” Neeraj Churi, founder of Lotus Visual Productions YIFF “For too long, queer filmmakers in India have faced challenges in securing funding and finding the right partners to bring their creative visions to life,” said Neeraj Churi, founder of Lotus Visual Productions and Sundance-winning producer of Cactus Pears . “And yet, some of the most exciting and original voices in Indian cinema are emerging from within the LGBTQIA+ community. We believe these filmmakers should have the opportunity to tell their own stories, on their own terms. The KSF Queer Grant is about creating that opportunity, combining financial support with mentorship and practical filmmaking guidance. Our hope is that this initiative will not only help make two films possible, but also open doors for a new generation of queer storytellers.” In addition to The Sailor & The Chef and Born Secret noted above, these are the short documentaries programmed in the 7 th edition of the Yellowstone International Film Festival: In the Silence After – (Doc Short) A son returns home to care for his mother, filming the last year they will spend together. Filmmaker – Sebastian Delascasas; Country – Colombia, United States; Runtime -16:50 No Matter the Weather – (Doc Short) Renée, 83, broke her ankle. Fortunately, she can rely on her granddaughter Florence, who steps in as her caregiver. While this ordeal brings them closer than ever, it inevitably confronts them with the reality of Renée’s decline. Filmmaker – Florence Lafond; Country – Canada; Runtime -14:30 A Sunflower in Delhi – (Doc Short) In a tiny women’s only beauty parlour, generations of devoted customers, including the filmmaker’s family, reflect on letting their hair go grey. The film meanders between the intimate oasis of the Sunflower Chinese Beauty Parlour and the bustling city landscape outside. articles.title: Web Summit Cancels Day Two As Storm Charles Hits Lisbon
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Stewart Clarke Stewart Clarke More Stories By Stewart Web Summit Cancels Day Two As Storm Charles Hits Lisbon ‘The Perfect Lie’ Actor Matthijs Van De Sande Bakhuyzen To Lead AFM-Bound Arctic Thriller ‘The Art Of Survival’ M. John Harrison Wins The 2026 Booker Prize With ‘The End Of Everything’ View All November 11, 2026 1:05am Add us as a Google Preferred Source L-R: Lucy Hyslop, Brooke Stites, Jess Kirkman Tyler Miller/Web Summit, Sportsfile, Getty Images Storm Charles has put paid to day two of Web Summit in Lisbon , Portugal. Organizers said it had shut down for the day on government advice and expects to be back up and running for day three on Thursday, November 12. Web Summit is an enormous event, attracting 70,000 attendees including tech leaders and politicians from around the world, as well as media execs and sports stars. Organizers notified delegates and speakers of the day two cancellation overnight. The Prime Minister of Portugal Luís Montenegro said Tuesday that his office had recommended Web Summit events be suspended given the expected impact of two storms, Bruna and Charles. He added the final decision rested with Web Summit organizers, who quickly decided to heed his advice. Related Stories News SAG-AFTRA Members Ratify TV Animation Contracts, Securing 12.6% Wage Increase For Voice Actors News SAG-AFTRA Votes To Extend Duncan Crabtree-Ireland's Contract With Updated Title Schools and shops have been closed in Lisbon, and local transport and non-essential public services are shutting down. Some flights have been delayed and cancelled. Watch on Deadline “The Government of Portugal has formally advised Web Summit that, due to the risks posed by Storm Charles, including tidal flooding, severe disruption to public transport and the impact of high winds on external structures, Day 2 of Web Summit should not take place,” organizers said. “This follows discussions with the Portuguese Government, the National Emergency and Civil Protection Authority (ANEPC), and the Public Security Police (PSP). Web Summit will of course respect the Government’s direction, and accordingly, Day 2 (Wednesday, November 11th) will not take place.” Organizers said they are working with the authorities and emergency services to monitor conditions but expect to proceed with events on Thursday as the storm passes. The day three lineup on Thursday is slated to include SAG AFTRA boss Duncan Crabtree-Ireland in a session entitled Hollywood’s Identity Crisis, moderated by Deadline. articles.title: Comedian Lucy Beaumont Fears Being Blacklisted By TV Industry After Blowing Whistle On David Walliams
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Jake Kanter Jake Kanter International Investigations Editor @Jake_Kanter More Stories By Jake Channel 4 Becomes Latest Network To Delete David Walliams Shows MGM+ Greenlights Gilded Age-Era Series ‘The American Heiress’ Starring Julianna Margulies Netflix Refuses To Remove Russell Brand Stand-Up Special Featuring Crude Sex Joke View All November 11, 2026 1:13am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Lucy Beaumont Sky News Comedian Lucy Beaumont has said she has risked her television career by speaking out about David Walliams because the industry doesn’t tolerate troublemakers. In an interview with Sky News (watch below), the Taskmaster star and Hullraisers writer revealed that she was one of the “whistleblowers” on Walliams, who has been accused of using his fame and power to prey on teenage girls. Walliams, known for Little Britain and Doctor Who , strongly denies wrongdoing. Beaumont told The Cathy Newman Show that a young person working on a TV show approached her with concerns that Walliams allegedly hosted teenagers in his dressing room. Beaumont said she contacted one of the young girls. Related Stories News David Walliams Being Cut From New Movie 'Fing!' Following Allegations; Comcast-Owned Sky Exits UK Distribution Of Film News 'Britain's Got Talent' Producer Urges "Anyone Who Feels They Have Been Subject Of Wrongdoing" To Come Forward Following David Walliams Allegations “She was in a really bad way,” Beaumont said. “I was really worried she was going to take her own life because of it. She had put stuff online, and there was evidence that she was in a dressing room. I offered to pay legal fees to try and get her some protection — and I’m not saying necessarily that what she said was true — but I wanted to help her because it was a world that she was really out of her depth with.” Watch on Deadline Beaumont continued: “I believe she had signed an NDA [non-disclosure agreement] to say — and this is the issue with some of these NDAs — the NDA wasn’t just about she couldn’t talk to the media. It was that she couldn’t — I’m nearly crying telling you this — talk to family or friends or a therapist.” She added: “There’s no proper duty of care. There’s no social services that you deal with, and it’s partly because the industry is very well-managed.” Turning to her decision to speak out, Beaumont said she doesn’t think she will work in television again because people “lose work” for challenging high-profile individuals and are painted as a “trouble causer.” She added that people are “very replaceable” in the business and there are “lots of other people who can do your job.” Beaumont joked that she would become a Pilates teacher. ITV News and The Guardian published their investigation into Walliams on Tuesday, detailing how he allegedly used his position on shows like Little Britain and Britain’s Got Talent to meet teenagers and pursue sexual contact with them. One of the teenagers was alleged to be 15 at the time of her interaction with Walliams. Beaumont said she spoke to The Guardian as part of its reporting. “I am not a sexual predator… I have not broken the law,” Walliams told ITV News. “I am devastated that some of the women I met ten to twenty years ago have now expressed hurt or anger towards me.” He continued: “Looking back, I realise that at times I behaved thoughtlessly towards other people I had casual sexual relationships with… I realise I did not always take people’s feelings properly into account. That is something I regret. And whilst a power imbalance is inevitable when one party is famous, abusing that power is something else entirely and it is something that I never did.” Sarandos Faces Unrest From Past & Present Execs Over Netflix’s Direction Matthias Schoenaerts & Diane Kruger Headline Thriller ‘The Writer’; Latest News ‘Saturday Night Live’ Hits 2-Year Viewership High With Host Druski ‘Mike Hammer’ Star, Film & Stage Actor, Dies At 85; Career In Photos Read More About: 1 Comments

articles.title: Jonathan Ross Explains Backstory Behind “Tasteless” David Walliams Joke
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Max Goldbart Max Goldbart International TV Co-Editor @Goldbart1 More Stories By Max James Graham’s BBC Drama ‘Sherwood’ To End After Season 3 Netflix’s ‘The Perfect Neighbor’ Beats ‘Mr Nobody Against Putin’ To Top Prize At UK Grierson Documentary Awards How The ‘Married At First Sight UK’ Scandal Has Impacted Hit Show Around The World View All November 11, 2026 1:39am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Jonathan Ross Lia Toby/Getty for the NTA's British TV presenter Jonathan Ross has landed himself in some hot water over the past week for his past association with both David Walliams and Russell Brand . The Guardian and ITV News’ report into allegations against Walliams including from teenagers referenced a joke Ross made at the 2004 British Comedy Awards. “The comedy awards is 15 years old – 15 years old! And like most 15-year-olds, it’s drunk, it’s unpredictable and it’s probably going home with David Walliams,” Ross joked at the time. Ross addressed the joke and the broader allegations this morning, saying in a statement he is “as horrified by the revelations about David Walliams and the crimes of Russell Brand as the rest of the nation.” Related Stories News Comedian Lucy Beaumont Fears Being Blacklisted By TV Industry After Blowing Whistle On David Walliams News David Walliams Being Cut From New Movie 'Fing!' Following Allegations; Comcast-Owned Sky Exits UK Distribution Of Film Ross said the “tasteless joke that I would not dream of making today about anyone” was submitted to him by the Comedy Awards writing team at the time. Watch on Deadline “I believed that the punchline was a reference to the fact he had publicly dated younger women, exaggerated for comic effect,” said Ross. “Had I had any reason to suspect that it might be referring to actual events, I would not only have refused to use it, but I would not have felt comfortable continuing a personal or professional relationship with him. I also like to think that I would have acted upon that knowledge.” Ross’ association with Walliams and Brand has been scrutinized in recent days. Along with the Comedy Awards joke, The Guardian published an image of Ross with Walliams at a charity quiz. In the photo, Ross is sat at a table while Walliams has his arm around an 18-year-old who accused Walliams of “pleading with me to share a bed with him” and “putting his head in my lap and making me stroke his head.” There is no suggestion that Ross was aware of any of the behavior Walliams has been accused of. Ross’ past association with Brand, who was jailed earlier this week for 10-and-a-half years for rape and sexual assault, has also come up in recent days. The pair created scandal in 2008 for prank calling Fawlty Towers actor Andrew Sachs and making lewd comments about his granddaughter, who had previously been in a relationship with Brand. After trying to have the articles blocked via the courts, the Walliams allegations dominated the news agenda yesterday and have called into question a culture that previously allowed men like Walliams and Brand to flourish. Culture Secretary Lisa Nandy said “the allegations are the latest in a long line of reported abuses of power in an industry where we have known for so long that the power imbalances are huge.” Walliams has been dropped by his agent and his shows including Little Britain have been removed from BBC iPlayer. He is accused of using his celebrity to prey on women as young as 15, making contact with them through work, including on Britain’s Got Talent , to pursue them for sexual purposes. Deadline has contacted Walliams’ legal representatives for comment. In a statement to ITV News, Walliams denied all allegations against him. When trying to prevent publication of the articles, Walliams’ lawyers revealed that he had made two attempts to take his life because of the allegations. “I am not a sexual predator… I have not broken the law,” Walliams said. “I am devastated that some of the women I met ten to twenty years ago have now expressed hurt or anger towards me.” He continued: “Looking back, I realise that at times I behaved thoughtlessly towards other people I had casual sexual relationships with… I realise I did not always take people’s feelings properly into account. That is something I regret. And whilst a power imbalance is inevitable when one party is famous, abusing that power is something else entirely and it is something that I never did.” Sarandos Faces Unrest From Past & Present Execs Over Netflix’s Direction Matthias Schoenaerts & Diane Kruger Headline Thriller ‘The Writer’; Latest News ‘Saturday Night Live’ Hits 2-Year Viewership High With Host Druski ‘Mike Hammer’ Star, Film & Stage Actor, Dies At 85; Career In Photos Read More About: Comments

articles.title: Lightdox Acquires Sales Rights To IDFA World Premiere ‘The Big Boom!’, Gabriel Tejedor Film With Explosive Contradictions
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Matthew Carey Matthew Carey Documentary Editor, Awards @mattcarey More Stories By Matthew Lightdox Acquires Sales Rights To IDFA World Premiere ‘The Big Boom!’, Gabriel Tejedor Film With Explosive Contradictions India’s Yellowstone International Film Festival Announces Documentary And LGBTQIA+ Slates Oscar Winner David Dinerstein Boards ‘Room Of The Absolute’ As EP; Award-Winning Doc Creates Portrait Of Ukrainian Artist Alla Hurenko View All November 11, 2026 2:02am Add us as a Google Preferred Source 'The Big Boom!' Mira Film Basel GmbH EXCLUSIVE: Lightdox has acquired world sales rights to The Big Boom! ahead of its world premiere in the Frontlight section of International Documentary Festival Amsterdam ( IDFA ). Swiss filmmaker Gabriel Tejedor directed the feature documentary that explores “the contradictions of a Bulgarian town pulled into Europe’s shifting geopolitical order, where arms production for Ukraine’s front lines collides with enduring ties to Russia, personal convictions, and the everyday need to survive.” The Big Boom! premieres at IDFA on Saturday. Watch the film’s trailer below. Related Stories Documentary Riz Ahmed Boards Elham Ehsas' Short Film 'Forgotten Spaceman' About Afghanistan's First Astronaut Documentary IDFA Announces Competition Lineups, Adds 'Musk' And Elizabeth Holmes Documentary 'You Can See Everything' The documentary contrasts ancient traditions in Kazanlak, Bulgaria’s “Valley of Roses,” with the town’s major industry – the Arsenal weapons factory. That defense contractor, founded in the 19 th century, “provides work for thousands of people manufacturing weapons and ammunition,” according to a synopsis. “Through the lives of four residents, Tejedor examines the place this industry occupies in the town’s economy and identity, and the questions it raises for those whose lives depend on it.” Watch on Deadline Mira Film Basel GmbH “ The Big Boom! brings us face to face with a contradiction at the heart of today’s Europe – a town making the weapons of war while struggling with its own loyalties and beliefs,” commented Lightdox CEO Anna Berthollet. “Gabriel Tejedor finds a way into this reality that feels both clear-eyed and deeply human. As someone of Bulgarian origin myself, I find his sensitive portrayal of Kazanlak and its people particularly meaningful. He reveals the layers of history, identity and geopolitical influence that shape the region without reducing them to a political argument. We’re delighted to bring this timely film to audiences worldwide.” The Big Boom! is the fifth feature directed by Tejedor, the filmmaker and journalist “whose work explores utopias and the relationship between individuals and authority across the former Soviet Union and its satellite states.” Director Gabriel Tejedor Mira Film Basel GmbH “I have never been interested in war or weapons. But the invasion of Ukraine shattered my convictions,” Tejedor said in a statement. “Ever since, one question has haunted me: what does it mean to be a pacifist today? I do not judge the workers at Arsenal, nor the local population. The Big Boom! does not seek to lecture, but to confront the grey zones of a continent trapped in its own paradoxes.” ‘ The Big Boom! ‘ Mira Film Basel GmbH The film is a production of Mira Film Basel GmbH, co-produced by RTS Radio Télévision Suisse, SRG SSR, with the support of Swiss and regional film funds and cultural institutions. Susanna Guggenberger produced The Big Boom! Cinematography is by Thomas Szczepanski; Christine Hoffet edited the film. The score is composed by Petar Dundakov. articles.title: How The ‘Married At First Sight UK’ Scandal Has Impacted Hit Show Around The World
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Max Goldbart Max Goldbart International TV Co-Editor @Goldbart1 More Stories By Max James Graham’s BBC Drama ‘Sherwood’ To End After Season 3 Entertainment 360 Acquires Max Stein’s Brigade Netflix’s ‘The Perfect Neighbor’ Beats ‘Mr Nobody Against Putin’ To Top Prize At UK Grierson Documentary Awards View All November 11, 2026 3:37am Add us as a Google Preferred Source EXCLUSIVE: The team behind Married at First Sight ( MAFS ) Australia is “reviewing” Channel 4’s report into the show, which has been axed in the UK following rape allegations. Deadline asked some of the teams behind versions of MAFS around the world whether they will take heed of the report. Australian broadcaster Channel Nine and MAFS producer Endemol Shine Australia told us they are “examining the findings,” while noting “many of the recommendations for improvement are already in place for MAFS Australia .” “We are always reviewing our participant protocols to ensure our participants’ safety and wellbeing,” added a spokeswoman for Endemol Shine Australia. “Production of MAFS Australia continues.” Related Stories News Channel 4 Cancels 'Married At First Sight UK' After Rape Allegations News Matthew Weiner Exits Eddie Murphy Peacock Series 'The Chairman' As Showrunner Channel 4 axed MAFS UK following rape allegations revealed earlier this year by BBC News, which the men accused of wrongdoing deny. Following these allegations being made public, two reviews were commissioned by Channel 4 CEO Priya Dogra, one examining welfare protocols and the other looking into whether changes should be made to protocols to strengthen contributor welfare in the future. While the latter, penned by ex-BBC One boss Lorraine Heggessey, suggested MAFS UK could continue if it took in some changes, Dogra axed the show last week. Watch on Deadline Many of the versions around the world are made by different production outfits than MAFS UK such as MAFS Australia , which is produced by Banijay-owned Endemol Shine Australia while the UK version is overseen by Seven.One Studios -owned CPL. The two versions are “separate productions and separate shows,” according to the Endemol Shine Australia spokeswoman. Deadline understands MAFS Australia protocols already in place that were suggested by Heggessey include cast being allowed to keep in touch with friends and family outside the show, a regular refresh of the show’s psychologists, and keeping casting and welfare teams separate. The Australia team have separate issues they are dealing with. New South Wales Police told BBC News last month that inquiries had taken place “following a report of inappropriate content being shared.” Channel Nine has confirmed that it is “aware of a police investigation.” There were also allegations, published by BBC News, that contestants were not told about their on-screen partners’ previous criminal convictions. Responding in a joint statement, Channel Nine and Endemol Shine Australia said they had “strong protocols in place to ensure participant safety and wellbeing.” In the U.S., MAFS is made by another different company, North Road-owned Kinetic Content. A spokeswoman declined comment on the Channel 4 review and whether MAFS could implement some of the recommendations in the States. We understand the American version is not currently filming and hasn’t been picked up for new seasons at this point. ‘MAFS UK’ still on sale MAFS is one of the world’s most successful formats. It originated in Denmark, where it still airs on local network DR1, produced by Seven.One-owned Snowman Productions. Seven.One told us other versions around the world that it controls remain business as usual, while its distribution arm will continue selling older editions of MAFS UK to global buyers. A Seven.One spokeswoman said: “The external reviews of contributor welfare on Married at First Sight UK confirmed that Channel 4 and production company CPL’s welfare protocols were compliant with the Ofcom Broadcasting Code; the Heggessey review found that they were ‘extensive, extremely thorough and of a high standard from which other productions in the industry have learnt’. Despite the findings of the reviews, Channel 4 has made the independent strategic decision not to continue the show. This decision has no impact on the show in other countries.” In the UK, however, the fallout from the cancelation continues. Its axing came on the day Russell Brand, a former Channel 4 presenter, was found guilty of rape and sexual assault . Several days later, allegations of sexually exploitative behavior towards women and teenagers were published about Little Britain co-creator David Walliams, who denies the allegations and says “I am not a sexual predator… I have not broken the law.” Channel 4 is moving on from MAFS . All past seasons of MAFS UK plus the American, Australian and New Zealand versions have been removed from Channel 4’s VoD platform, while a planned spin-off has been cancelled. Channel 4 boss Dogra was merely a few weeks into the job when the MAFS UK allegations broke. She will likely face questions on the show when she appears in front of a parliamentary committee on Tuesday and has said its “considerable budget” will now be used to “find the next generation of distinctive and disruptive British television.” This will be a key task for new programs chief David Brindley, who starts in a few weeks’ time. articles.title: ‘Days Of Our Lives’ Actor James Reynolds Reveals Parkinson’s Diagnosis; Condition Being Written Into Storyline
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Greg Evans Greg Evans NY & Broadway Editor @GregEvans5 More Stories By Greg ‘Days Of Our Lives’ Actor James Reynolds Reveals Parkinson’s Diagnosis; Condition Being Written Into Storyline ‘Much Ado About Nothing’ With Tom Hiddleston & Hayley Atwell Sells Out, Tops $2M Gross; ‘Here There Are Blueberries’, ‘Downstate’, ‘Fantasticks’ Fill Seats – Broadway Box Office Richard Schiff Among Cast Added To Broadway’s ‘Awake And Sing!’ Revival View All November 11, 2026 8:01am Add us as a Google Preferred Source James Reynolds at 2018 Daytime Emmy Awards Getty James Reynolds , who has played Abe Carver on Days of Our Lives for 45 years, has revealed that he’s been diagnosed with Parkinson’s disease and that his condition will be worked into the storyline of the long-running soap. In an interview with ET (watch it below), Reynolds, 80, concedes that he initially tried to mask his symptoms while on set but that he was increasingly unsuccessful. Asked about the decision to address the diagnosis within the storyline, Reynolds said, “Well, it kind of goes back to when I thought I was hiding it. The writers also wanted to incorporate because it was obvious. It was obvious. And we play life here.” Related Stories News 'Days Of Our Lives' Actor Robert Kelker-Kelly's Cause Of Death Revealed Casting 'Days Of Our Lives' Casts Long-Awaited Dominic Marino Reynolds continued, “And there are many other characters who have gone through real-life issues that then are mirrored on the show, and this is an issue that it is going to be mirrored on the show and there’s nothing any of us can really do about it.” Watch on Deadline The actor, who is the longest-running Black actor in a single series in television history, said he feels his character is particularly well-suited to the storyline. “I feel like the value of Abe as a character [is he] overcomes a lot, has tremendous amount of strength, deals with a lot of things with humor as well as understanding.” Reynolds, who has kept his diagnosis private except for family for a few years, says the symptoms – shaky hands, occasional balance issues, sometimes a shortness of breath – become increasingly difficult to conceal. “I thought I was hiding it but I wasn’t. You play that game with yourself.” The actor said in the last few weeks he realized he might have been showing early symptoms – “horrible dreams” that caused him to thrash and fall out of bed – as long as 15 to 20 years ago, a realization he said he came to after watching actor Alan Alda’s recent interview on C BS Sunday Morning, during which Alda said his earliest Parkinsons symptom was acting out his dreams. (Watch Alda’s interview below.) articles.title: Britt Robertson Joins Kellan Lutz In Faith-Based Survival Thriller ‘The Rescue’ — AFM
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Andreas Wiseman Andreas Wiseman Executive Editor, Film & International @AndreasWiseman More Stories By Andreas Britt Robertson Joins Kellan Lutz In Faith-Based Survival Thriller ‘The Rescue’ — AFM Andy Garcia Joins Tim Roth & Timothy Spall In ‘Murdering Michael Malloy’ — AFM May El-Toukhy’s Venice Golden Lion Winner ‘Woman Unknown’ Gets U.S. Deal During AFM View All November 11, 2026 8:05am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Britt Robertson and Kellan Lutz Getty/Courtesy EXCLUSIVE : Britt Robertson ( Tomorrowland ) is joining Kellan Lutz in faith-based survival thriller The Rescue , which Premiere Entertainment will continue selling at the AFM . Production is scheduled to begin in New Zealand in February 2027. Pic will be directed by Darren Simmonds and Jared van Berkel from a screenplay written by van Berkel. Simon Ambridge, Anton Steel and Jared van Berkel will produce. The synopsis reads: “After a violent storm leaves a rescue team stranded on a frozen Alaskan mountain, survival becomes a test of endurance and faith. As temperatures drop and resources dwindle, the team must find strength in one another as hope begins to fade.” I Still Believe and Tomorrowland actress Robertson will star opposite Twilight and Expendables actor Lutz. Watch on Deadline “ The Rescue has everything international audiences respond to: a recognizable cast, an expansive survival story, and a powerful emotional message,” said Elias Axume, CEO of Premiere Entertainment Group. “Britt and Kellan are a terrific combination, and we’re excited to introduce the film to buyers at AFM.” Sarandos Faces Unrest From Past & Present Execs Over Netflix’s Direction ‘Mike Hammer’ Star, Film & Stage Actor, Dies At 85; Career In Photos Jason Orley Directing New Take On Rom-Com ‘You’ve Got Mail’ For Warner Bros Leah McKendrick Sets ‘Voicemails From Isabelle’ Follow-Up; Maddie Ziegler Stars Read More About: Comments

articles.title: M. John Harrison On Early Adaptation Interest & Why He Almost Added ‘A Film’ To His Booker-Winning Novel’s Title
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Stewart Clarke Stewart Clarke More Stories By Stewart M. John Harrison On Early Adaptation Interest & Why He Almost Added ‘A Film’ To His Booker-Winning Novel’s Title Charlie Sheen’s ‘Mostly Sheenius’ Podcast Lines Up Michael Douglas As First Guest: Rob Lowe, Martin Sheen & Denise Richards Also Set To Appear Web Summit Cancels Day Two As Storm Charles Hits Lisbon View All November 11, 2026 8:05am Add us as a Google Preferred Source M. John Harrison Wiktor Szymanowicz/Getty Images With interest in a big-screen adaptation, M. John Harrison has told Deadline he wanted to call his Booker Prize -winning novel ‘ The End of Everything : A Film’, but got cold feet at the last minute. Harrison won the Booker for ‘The End of Everything’, to give his book its final title. It follows a beachcomber living on the English coast after a disaster has struck. He finds a mysterious object in the sea and brings it inland. As well as spurring book sales, there is always sharp interest in adapting Booker titles. ‘The End of Everything’ has distinctive landscapes and characters as well as mysterious shape-shifting alien entities called the iGhetti. Related Stories News M. John Harrison Wins The 2026 Booker Prize With 'The End Of Everything' News Douglas Stuart, Marlon James & Elizabeth Strout Among 13 Authors On The Booker Prize Longlist; Organizers Say 2026 Selection "Rewards Risk" Fresh from winning the prestigious literary award, Harrison told Deadline that he visualized scenes from the book as he wrote them, and noted, as have others, that his novel has a cinematic quality. Watch on Deadline “When I’ve constructed a scene, when I turn it into words, I can see it. And I was, in fact, going to subtitle this novel ‘The End of Everything: A Film’. I lost my nerve at the last minute, but I now really wish I’d done it, because it’s got the structure of a kind of middle-European film, with the right provenance to be very watchable indeed.” The book is published by the Serpent’s Tail imprint, marking its first Booker win. Similarly, it was the first win for 81-year-old Harrison who served as a Booker judge in 2022. “We do have some interest, it hasn’t gone far enough to be able to talk about [in detail], but there is interest in doing something,” the writer told Deadline when asked if an adaptation was in the works. Harrison would rather his book came to screen as a movie than a series. His take is it would be a European-flavored film, with someone of the ilk of late and pioneering Hungarian director Béla Tarr at the helm. “I think for me, personally, if it were to happen, that it would be a film. And it would remind you either of a difficult French film, or a Béla Tarr film,” Harrison said. The author is an avowed movie fan, but whether he would be involved in any adaptation of his lauded book is not clear. “I watch lots of films, I love films,” he said. “But it’s like art, I see a lot of paintings, but I don’t know a great deal about how they’re painted and therefore I wouldn’t feel entirely comfortable being involved in a process like that.” He added that he could envisage how the book might work on screen, and how an adaptation could win his approval. “There are ways that that that book would have to be done to be made into a film that made me excited – that continued my excitement from writing the book – but I have faith that I might find somebody who could do that.” Booker Chief Executive Gaby Wood has also noted the filmic qualities in ‘The End of Everything’ and has said: “Readers will also recognize many tropes from cinema: the disaster movie, the road movie, the couple on the run, the noir heroine with a gun in her bag, the apocalypse.” Harrison pushes against classifications such as science fiction although that is the genre his work, stretching to 13 novels, is placed in. Booker’s Wood noted that he is the first winner “to have emerged from the bona fide SF world.” Sarandos Faces Unrest From Past & Present Execs Over Netflix’s Direction Matthias Schoenaerts & Diane Kruger Headline Thriller ‘The Writer’; Latest News ‘Saturday Night Live’ Hits 2-Year Viewership High With Host Druski ‘Mike Hammer’ Star, Film & Stage Actor, Dies At 85; Career In Photos Read More About: Comments

articles.title: Peacock Phasing In Mobile Updates, With Vertical ‘Voice’ Clips, More Home Screen Sports, Browsing Tweaks & More
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Dade Hayes Dade Hayes Business Editor @dadehayes More Stories By Dade Film Accelerator Open Cities, Run By Ex-Sundance CEO Joana Vicente & Producer Jason Kliot, Reveals First Projects ‘Tangles’ Cast Members Seth Rogen, Julia Louis-Dreyfus & Bryan Cranston On Animated Film’s Rare Back Story AMC Global Media Posts Mixed Q3, Previews ‘The Walking Dead’ AMC+ Bow View All November 11, 2026 8:07am Add us as a Google Preferred Source NBCUniversal ‘s Peacock is ushering in a number of updates to its mobile app, overhauling the browsing experience, putting more sports on the home screen and expanding its vertical video offerings. The updates encompass a wide range of features, from overhauled browsing to a “jump back in” button to an influx of vertical video spanning clips and microdramas. The strategic goal of the updates is to connect with subscribers at key moments throughout the day and increase viewing time, recognizing the role that mobile devices now play in the streaming ecosystem. Just as traditional mobile players like YouTube have been leaning into the living room, legacy media players like NBCU are putting increasing emphasis on their mobile offerings after beginning on their most familiar device, the TV screen. Related Stories News How The 'Married At First Sight UK' Scandal Has Impacted Hit Show Around The World News HBO Max-Paramount+ Bundle Set To Launch In Early 2027, David Ellison Confirms Last month, NBCU parent Comcast said Peacock delivered its second straight quarter of profitability during the third quarter, though its subscriber level stayed flat at 48 million. Watch on Deadline During a press briefing in New York on Tuesday, Matt Strauss, Chairman of NBCUniversal Media Group, said he wasn’t at all discouraged by Peacock’s scale six-plus years after its launch. He pointed to the long-term strategy of the service, which started up at a very different moment for the media business, when ad-free binge releases seemed like the inevitable future. Peacock initially was mostly focused on its free, ad tier, and today still has 80% of its subscribers on its cheaper ad-supported plan. “We arguably didn’t build Peacock to win a streaming war. We built Peacock for growth in the aftermath of a streaming war,” Strauss said. “And that’s where I think we are right now, which is the next phase of growth is going to be around who can win another hour per user per month. And to go and evaluate through that lens, you have to think differently about the user experience. And the phone and mobile has to be a first-class citizen.” Testing is already under way on many of the features, which will go live and be updated continuously through early 2027. Peacock is enhancing its search capabilities with conversational AI, looking to enhance personalization. The updates build on existing features like Your Bravoverse, Clips Feed, and Peacock Performance View. John Jelley, SVP of Product and UX for the NBCUniversal Media Group, emphasized the company’s efforts to tailor its AI approach to the streaming realm. “We combine that in what we call a large action model,” he said during the press briefing. “Rather than predicting the next word as LLMs do, we’re actually predicting the next action.” Vertical video has been on Peacock for nearly two years now, with the service pioneering the format for live sports. NBCU’s long-term rights deal with the NBA, which began in 2025, offered an opportunity to showcase the technology, which will now be expanding to shows like NBC mainstay The Voice . Other sports like college basketball and golf will also get the vertical treatment. Microdramas, which have grown into a multi-billion-dollar category and are seen as a potent on-ramp for streaming viewers, will be an increasing presence on Peacock. At least one new micro title will land on the service each week, the company is promising. These series are generally licensed from third parties but in some cases are commissioned in-house, as in the case of Bravo scripted microdramas like the recently premiered Charmed by a Southern Monster . Spanish-language NBCU subsidiary Telemundo has already been pushing into the microdrama space. “NBCUniversal has an unmatched ability to turn the shows, sports and stories fans love into experiences that extend well beyond the screen,” said Jim Denney, Chief Product Officer, Global Streaming & NBCUniversal Media Group. “Our ambition is for Peacock to be more than a place to watch. With this new mobile experience, we’re evolving Peacock into an entertainment platform that gives fans more ways to discover, participate and strengthen their connection to their favorite stories, teams and franchises, turning viewing into deeper engagement and lasting fandom and loyalty.” Peacock is exploring new setups on its home screen to help viewers quickly “jump back in” to programming they enjoy. Hubs devoted to key franchises will lead not only to episodic fare but also games, microdramas, podcasts, clips and other related material. articles.title: Matthias Schoenaerts & Diane Kruger Headline ‘The Writer’, Thriller Set In Underground Graffiti Art World — AFM
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Andreas Wiseman Andreas Wiseman Executive Editor, Film & International @AndreasWiseman More Stories By Andreas Andy Garcia Joins Tim Roth & Timothy Spall In ‘Murdering Michael Malloy’ — AFM May El-Toukhy’s Venice Golden Lion Winner ‘Woman Unknown’ Gets U.S. Deal During AFM VMI Launches AFM Sales On Manila-Set Action Pic ‘Big Tiger’ With Luke Goss & Katherine McNamara View All November 11, 2026 8:15am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Matthias Schoenaerts and Diane Kruger Filip Van Roe/Sebastian Kim EXCLUSIVE : César winner Matthias Schoenaerts ( Rust and Bone ) and Cannes best actress winner Diane Kruger ( Inglourious Basterds ) will star in The Writer , set in the underground graffiti art world. Schoenaerts will portray “a battle-scarred New York graffiti legend who is thrust into the global spotlight when his painting, stolen from a Paris subway tunnel, ignites a Sotheby’s frenzy—and a war for his crown.” The film marks the directorial debut of writer-director Matt Cirulnick, who penned the NYC crime and hip-hop film Paid In Full . Production is slated for New York in 2027. Obsession outfit Capstone Global is launching international sales on the project at the AFM this week. Related Stories News Britt Robertson Joins Kellan Lutz In Faith-Based Survival Thriller 'The Rescue' -- AFM News California Pictures Boards World Sales On Bengali Gothic Horror 'The Undying' -- AFM Schoenaerts and Kruger last shared the screen in Alice Winocour’s Disorder , which premiered in Un Certain Regard at the 2015 Cannes Film Festival. Watch on Deadline Marina Grasic, Jonathan Avildsen, and Jason Taylor are producing. Gary Lucchesi, Christian Mercuri, and Ruzanna Kegeyan serve as executive producers. New Yorker Avildsen, the son of Oscar-winning filmmaker John G. Avildsen ( Rocky ), has been part of the city’s graffiti culture for forty years. He will create and curate the film’s art and assemble real graffiti writers to contribute. “As a lifelong New Yorker, this is a world for which I’ve always had a fierce passion,” said Cirulnick. “Jonathan Avildsen and Matthias are key to making it authentically— and with Diane, it’s a filmmaker’s dream.” “Graffiti is a global language,” said producer Jason Taylor. “It’s in every city on earth and it’s never had its definitive modern film.” “In Matthias and Diane we have two of the finest actors in cinema today to carry this original film,” said producer Marina Grasic. “The dialogue, the characters, rang so true to me,” said producer and technical advisor Jonathan Avildsen. “I’m excited to help bring this script to life authentically.” Cirulnick is repped by Brillstein Entertainment Partners and Gersh. articles.title: ‘Saturday Night Live’ Hits 2-Year Viewership High With Host Druski
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Nellie Andreeva Nellie Andreeva Editor-In-Chief @DeadlineNellie More Stories By Nellie ‘Saturday Night Live’ Hits 2-Year Viewership High With Host Druski Veteran Talent Agent Sasha Passero Leaving IAG Efrain Miron Joins Skydance’s Product & Technology Team As Chief Commercial Officer After DTC Exit View All November 11, 2026 8:17am Add us as a Google Preferred Source 'Saturday Night Live': Host Druski during the Monologue on Nov. 7, 2026 Will Heath/NBC Cue in more digital creators hosting Saturday Night Live after Druski , the first online personality to emcee NBC’s venerable sketch comedy series, delivered the most watched episode in two years. The Nov. 4 show, hosted by Druski with musical guest The Strokes, drew 5.6 million Live+Same Day viewers across NBC and Peacock, up from the then-season high 5.2 million mark set the previous week by Inde Navarrette with musical guest Gracie Abrams. That’s the largest audience since the Nov. 2, 2024 SNL episode — the last before the Presidential Election — hosted by John Mulaney with musical guest Chappell Roan, which delivered 6.8 million L+SD viewers. Related Stories Commentary Druski's 'SNL' Gig Marks The Start Of The Creator Economy's Franchise Era - Guest Column News Druski Leads One Of 'SNL's Most Star-Studded Curtain Calls Ever With Emma Stone, Michael B. Jordan, Austin Butler, Plus Chappelle, Rock, Goggins Coincidentally, SNL alum Mulaney is back as host this Saturday with musical guest Phoebe Bridgers. Watch on Deadline Druski brought his young fan base and social media prowess to SNL. In adults 18-49 demo, this was the highest rated episode in two years, going back to the same Nov. 2, 2024 show. But in adults 18-34, this was SNL ‘s best delivery in over four years, dating back to May 8, 2021 with host Elon Musk and musical guest Miley Cyrus. On social, the episode generated 424 million views as of Tuesday morning across YouTube, Facebook, X (Twitter), Instagram and TikTok, the most since last December’s Ariana Grande-hosted episode. Additionally, the Druski-hosted SNL episode was the most watched ever on Peacock. Saturday Night Live is produced in association with Broadway Video. The creator and executive producer is Lorne Michaels. Known for her reporting as a leading authority on the global shadow economy, Van Zeller has led investigations into the opioid crisis, immigration and the explosion of scamming as a global industry. The latter is the subject of her new feature doc Super Scam Me , released Oct. 17 on Hulu, Disney+ and National Geographic. As co-founder of Muck Media, Van Zeller hosted and executive produced their flagship series Trafficked with Mariana van Zeller for National Geographic. The series earned 16 Emmy wins and 88 nominations over five seasons. Other Muck Media titles include the Emmy-nominated Sundance doc Science Fair , Netflix’s Mucho Mucho Amor and The Fall of El Mayo , and HBO Max’s American Pain . Born and raised in Portugal, Van Zeller studied journalism at Columbia University. Her work has been recognized with a Peabody Award, a duPont-Columbia Award, a Television Academy Honor and the Livingston Award for Young Journalists. She also hosts The Hidden Third , a weekly podcast about crime, black markets and the people who live inside them. Watch on Deadline WME will work with Van Zeller to expand her business across documentaries, television, digital audio and video, publishing and beyond. The journalist continues to be managed by Michael Lasker and Nate Dixon at Mosaic. articles.title: Justin Long, Banks Pierce & Katy Mixon Greer Starring In Family Pic ‘Slater’s Gold’; Producer-Director Launches Texas Studio — AFM
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Andreas Wiseman Andreas Wiseman Executive Editor, Film & International @AndreasWiseman More Stories By Andreas Britt Robertson Joins Kellan Lutz In Faith-Based Survival Thriller ‘The Rescue’ — AFM Andy Garcia Joins Tim Roth & Timothy Spall In ‘Murdering Michael Malloy’ — AFM May El-Toukhy’s Venice Golden Lion Winner ‘Woman Unknown’ Gets U.S. Deal During AFM View All November 11, 2026 8:47am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Justin Long, Banks Pierce and Katy Mixon Greer Getty/Courtesy EXCLUSIVE : Justin Long ( Dodgeball ) and Katy Mixon Greer ( American Housewife ) will star with Banks Pierce ( The Pitt ) in family film Slater’s Gold. Also starring are Kate Wilson, Henry Heffernan, Keith Rushing, Brooke Lyons, Harrison C. Thomas, Todd Terry and Glenn Morshower. The film from writer, director and lead producer Micah Lyons ( Bad Men Must Bleed ) recently wrapped production after shooting in Shreveport, Louisiana and will be screening privately for potential buyers and sales agents at this week’s AFM in LA. Related Stories News Matthias Schoenaerts & Diane Kruger Headline 'The Writer', Thriller Set In Underground Graffiti Art World -- AFM News Britt Robertson Joins Kellan Lutz In Faith-Based Survival Thriller 'The Rescue' -- AFM Slater’s Gold “follows 13-year-old Slater (Banks Pierce), as he discovers a mysterious clue linked to lost Civil War gold. Determined to help his impoverished single-mother (Katy Mixon Greer) escape the clutches of her scheming fiancé, Everett (Justin Long), Slater sets out on a dangerous adventure through rural Louisiana swampland with his little brother Noah (Henry Heffernan) and his fearless crush Lindsay (Kate Wilson). Guided by the wisdom of his grandfather (Keith Rushing), Slater must navigate the terrifying town-recluse, unforgiving terrain, a dilapidated salt mine, and find the treasure before it’s too late. But with Everett standing in their way, Slater soon discovers that some things are worth far more than gold.” Watch on Deadline Slater’s Gold , is produced by Breath of Life Productions in association with Bleu Bayou Pictures and Aisle7 Post, with Micah Lyons, Bridget Uhles, J.C. Doler, and Harrison C. Thomas serving as producers. The team also includes Keith Rushing as executive producer and Eric Gibson as line producer. Slater’s Gold creative team includes cinematographer William Hellmuth, casting director Tracy Kilpatrick and music by Erick Schroder. Original story and songs are by Keith Rushing, screenplay is by Micah Lyons. The film marks the launch of Lyons Family Studios, a full-service film and TV studio with three sound stages and an LED Volume headquartered in Longview, Texas. In 2027, Lyons Family Studios and Breath of Life Productions will release Stigmas (in post-production), a romantic thriller starring Amelie Anstett, Robert Knepper, Mia Fugate, Harrison C. Thomas and Leah Kate, and is gearing up to shoot the Latina-driven story of Lost Girl , based on the story of Rebecca Contreras. According to the producers, Lost Girl is financed and currently in the development, packaging and casting phase. Filming is slated for spring 2027 at the Lyons Family Studios. Inspired by his own childhood, writer-director Micah Lyons shared: “I am so proud to be a part of this amazing and heartfelt story. As a child of the 90s, my aim was to make something that felt just like the films I grew up on – equal parts fun, authentic and emotionally rich, highlighting real situations that real kids go through every day across America. As an ode to the classics like Stand By Me and The Sandlot , this is the movie that millennials have been begging Hollywood to make since we were kids!” Justin Long is represented by Independent Artist Group and Yorn Levine. articles.title: Gabriella Yacyk Joins Unicorn As Head Of Comedy
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Matt Grobar Matt Grobar Senior Film Reporter More Stories By Matt Paul Wesley Latest To Join Netflix’s ‘Icebreaker’ ‘Chucky’ Creator Don Mancini Signs With Independent Artist Group Lisa Edelstein, Kevin Pollak & Joe Swanberg Among New Additions To SM Goldberger’s ‘Your Heart Is A Hummingbird’ View All November 11, 2026 8:53am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Gabriella Yacyk Matthew Gilbertson EXCLUSIVE: Unicorn , the 360 management firm and content studio, has expanded its executive team with the hiring of Gabriella Yacyk . Yacyk, most recently Senior Director of Development at The Second City, will lead talent management and IP development for Unicorn’s comedy division, reporting directly to co-CEOs Scott Dunn and Chris Gera. “Gabriella is a true comedy industry unicorn, who cut her teeth at some of the most iconic comedy institutions,” Dunn and Gera said. “Welcoming her to our leadership team underscores our desire to identify and foster singular comedic voices, serving as true partners to talent as they work to develop new and exciting content.” Related Stories Late Night TV James Talarico Stuns 'SNL' With Post-Midterms Cameo & "Trump Freezers" Swipe Podcast Comedians Leslie Liao & Jason Cheny Team With All Things Comedy On 'Happy Fun Times' Podcast During her nearly three years at The Second City, the legendary comedy institution that helped launch the careers of everyone from Bill Murray and John Belushi to Tina Fey and Steve Carell, Yacyk spearheaded their expansion into original media for all platforms. She oversaw a slate of scripted and unscripted television, podcasts and digital originals, and launched their first digital comedy ensemble, an initiative focused on developing emerging comedic talent through original short-form content. Watch on Deadline Prior to The Second City, Yacyk held development roles at Comedy Central, where she worked with emerging and established comedians including Bowen Yang, Rachel Sennott, Ayo Edebiri, Benito Skinner, Mary Beth Barone and Stavros Halkias. Her work spanned talent development, original programming and stand-up, including Comedy Central’s Up Next showcase, Comedy Central Stand-Up Presents and hour-long stand-up specials Esther Povitsky: Hot for My Name and Josh Johnson: #(Hashtag) . Based in Gowanus, NY, Unicorn launched in April 2025 under the leadership of creator economy veterans Dunn and Gera. Previously, Dunn co-created popular digital properties Recess Therapy and Bob Does Sports at Doing Things Media, while Gera led digital content strategy at BuzzFeed and Comedy Central. Unicorn’s hiring of Yacyk emphasizes their goal of further expansion into the comedy content realm, both by building long-term infrastructure and support for comedic clients, and developing innovative IP. One recent effort in IP building is the YouTube show Human Trials , hosted by comedian Mark Normand, where comedians perform for hyper-specific live audiences — i.e., 50 bald men, 50 Gen-Z girls or 50 clowns. The show garnered 25 million views in its first week.
