articles.title: ‘The Celebrity Traitors’ Star James Acaster Trashes Report That He Made Complaint About Co-Stars
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Jake Kanter Jake Kanter International Investigations Editor @Jake_Kanter More Stories By Jake Russell Brand Trial: Jury Begins Verdict Deliberations British Star Loses Bid To Stop ITN & Guardian Publishing Sexual Misconduct Allegations UK Theme Park Alton Towers Permanently Closes David Walliams Attraction View All November 3, 2026 1:13am Add us as a Google Preferred Source James Acaster on 'The Celebrity Traitors' BBC James Acaster has said it is “completely fabricated” that he complained about The Celebrity Traitors co-stars, Rob Beckett and Romesh Ranganathan . On Alan Carr’s Life’s A Beach Podcast , the Ghostbusters: Frozen Empire star was incredulous about a report in The Mail on Sunday claiming he told Celebrity Traitors producers that he was uncomfortable with “macho banter” during filming. “I’ve never had stuff made up about me before,” Acaster told Carr, who won the first season of The Celebrity Traitors on the BBC. “There was something in the papers that said I’d complained cos Rob and Romesh had been teasing me.” Related Stories News 'The Celebrity Traitors' Finale Draws Record Audience To BBC News 'The Celebrity Traitors': BBC Says It's "Categorically Untrue" James Acaster Made Complaint About Co-Stars' "Macho Banter" “I was like: I’ve been friends with those guys for like over 10 years. They were lovely the entire show. I didn’t complain about any of my fellow players. It was so completely fabricated. They contacted my agents and Rob and Romesh’s agents [and] all of them said: ‘That is categorically untrue.’ They [the Mail ] went: ‘Cool, printing it tomorrow.'” Watch on Deadline In a story splashed on the front page of the Mail on Sunday last month, the newspaper quoted a “snitch” on the show as saying: “Rob and Romesh clearly thought they were having a bit of a laugh, but James began to feel quite a lot of it was at his expense, and away from the cameras he started to get annoyed and upset by it. In the end, he spoke to the production team about it, saying he was unhappy and felt like he was being singled out.” The newspaper doubled down over the weekend, reporting that Beckett and Ranganathan had made jokes about Acaster’s middle-class background. “He felt that the game was difficult enough without what he perceived to be a separate battle with them over his social background,” the Mail on Sunday quoted a source as saying. The BBC also issued a forceful denial. A spokesperson said: “Claims of teasing amongst the cast on the show and claims of complaints about teasing are categorically untrue. There were no incidents of this nature and there is no evidence to support these allegations.” Acaster told Alan Carr’s Life’s A Beach Podcast that he admitted being a traitor to fellow contestant Jerry Hall, but the scene did not make the final edit. “I looked her in the eye and said, ‘I think it might be me too, Jerry,’ and she said, ‘You’re very sneaky.’ And I told her I was very sneaky and it might be me,” he said. articles.title: ‘Queen Silvia’ Team Hopes For Multiple Seasons After Royal Drama’s Cannes Premiere
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Stewart Clarke Stewart Clarke More Stories By Stewart More International Deals For ‘Sherlock & Daughter’ Ahead Of UK & Ireland Premiere On HBO Max ‘Queen Silvia’ Team Hopes For Multiple Seasons After Royal Drama’s Cannes Premiere Terry Sanders Wraps Documentary ‘On Rescuing Democracy And The Rule Of Law’ View All November 3, 2026 1:21am Add us as a Google Preferred Source 'Queen Silvia' Becker Films, Amazon, Joyn, Pyjama Pictures Queen Silvia was crowned in Cannes with a world premiere screening for the upcoming royal drama series. German actress Alicia von Rittberg ( Call My Agent Berlin ), who stars as the titular Silvia Sommerlath, and Swedish actor Edvin Endre ( Vikings ), who plays Crown Prince Carl Gustaf, were in town for the premiere. A grand piano was in situ in the auditorium for a live performance of Dancing Queen, the megahit that ABBA performed at a pre-wedding gala for the royal couple. The royal romance is destined for Prime Video in German-speaking territories and the Nordics and SAT.1 in Germany. Beta Film is selling it internationally. SVT has taken a second window in Sweden. Related Stories News 'Carrie's Mike Flanagan Reflects On Supernatural YA Drama & Says 'Warhammer 40,000' Series Has "Very Cool And Unexpected On-Ramp" News Amazon Shares Fall On Q3 Earnings Miss As Big Tech Market Rout Continues “Royal love stories are working tremendously well,” Justus Riesenkampff, EVP Nordics & Benelux at Beta Film, told Deadline. “We’ve had a lot of classic period pieces, but people are intrigued in these modern royal stories. Queen Silvia has a lot of elements that will also resonate with the younger audiences. It is an ideal setup and also has the potential for future seasons.” Watch on Deadline Silvia met Carl Gustaf, the Crown Prince of Sweden, when he was a guest at the ill-fated 1972 Munich Olympic Games, where Silvia was working. Season 1 focuses on the early years of their relationship, from the day they met until the eve of their marriage. “At first glance, it’s a classical royal story; a noble person marries a commoner,” said Carsten Kelber, Producer at German label Pyjama Pictures, which produces with Sweden’s Unlimited Stories. “But in this story it is very different and there are a lot of surprises that lie within the main characters and their backgrounds,” He added” “A lot of the usual tropes or patterns are turned upside down in this story. The genre is clear, it’s a romantic drama, but it’s also a very modern view on relationships and female empowerment.” The royal couple remain married and a regal drama that includes many characters still alive has echoes of The Crown as well as Dutch series Máxima , which Beta also distributes. The Queen Silvia producers notified the royal family the series was happening. Miguel Alexandre ( Gran Paradiso ) directs from a screenplay he penned with Lisa Hofer ( Black Island ) and Pauline Wolff ( VAKA ). As with shows that have gone before such as The Crown , the series covers real-life historic milestones, but the conversations and drama that took place behind closed doors is where the writers’ skills come into play. Kelber said: “What happened in the car on the way to the event? What did they talk about, what was his or her take on what was happening? This is the fun thing to think about. It is, of course, fictional freedom. Our director likes to call it ‘poetic truth.’” The setup lends itself very naturally to a big European drama involving producers from Sweden and Germany. “The story takes place both in Germany and Sweden and they move back and forth and there are both Swedish and German characters in it; it’s very seamlessly a [Swedish-German] coproduction,” said Frida Wallman from Unlimited Stories. Given Season 1 takes in four years of a relationship that has lasted over half a century, the hope is for multiple seasons. “I would hope for many,” Kelber said. “Each phase of this marriage is so interesting.” Disney To Undergo More Layoffs With 20% Divisional Cost Savings Eyed Jason Statham & Guy Ritchie Reunite For Netflix Feature ‘Dogfight’ Boost California Tax Incentive To $1 Billion-Plus ASAP, Exiting Governor Says ‘Elsinore’ Leads British Independent Film Awards Nominations Read More About: Comments

articles.title: Bosses At ‘Clangold’ Producer Beetz Brothers Hail Skydance For Backing Casey Bloys: “A Strong Sign The HBO Line Will Continue”
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Jesse Whittock Jesse Whittock International TV Co-Editor @WhittockTweets More Stories By Jesse Titan1Studios Adapting Stephen R. Bown’s ‘The Company: The Rise and Fall Of The Hudson’s Bay Empire’ As Historical Drama Series Bosses At ‘Clangold’ Producer Beetz Brothers Hail Skydance For Backing Casey Bloys: “A Strong Sign The HBO Line Will Continue” ‘Carrie’s Mike Flanagan Reflects On Supernatural YA Drama & Says ‘Warhammer 40,000’ Series Has “Very Cool And Unexpected On-Ramp” View All November 3, 2026 2:00am Add us as a Google Preferred Source 'Clangold' HBO Max/Eveliene Klink Ever since Paramount and Warner Bros. merged, producers around the world have been wondering what it will mean for their prospects. For Germany ‘s Beetz Brothers , which launches crime doc Clangold on HBO Max globally on November 13, the appointment of Casey Bloys as Skydance’s content chief is a “strong sign” those making high-end, mainstream productions will be well served. Georg Tschurtschenthaler, Chief Creative Officer at the Berlin-based Beetz, addressed the merger in an interview with Deadline, noting that “some information” about the new business was trickling down to international producers. Related Stories News 'The Gilded Age' Season 4 Star Taissa Farmiga Talks Gladys' "Intense" First Episode Executives Skydance TV & DTC Co-Chair JB Perrette Unveils Leadership Team, Executive Departures “There was relief because Casey Bloys remains at the top of the structure, which is a strong sign that the HBO line will continue,” he said. “The launch of [HBO Max drama] Four Blocks Zero was a big thing in Germany. All the newspapers reported on it, and internationally it reached the HBO top 10. That was a very good push. The signs seem positive, although that is simply what we know at this stage.” Watch on Deadline Christian Beetz, co-CEO and co-founder at Beetz, added discussions for program orders remain separate with HBO Max and Paramount+, though Skydance co-CEO David Ellison has said they will eventually merge into one service. “They currently have very different programs,” he said. “I think there is still some time to go.” HBO Max’s upcoming four-part doc Clangold centers on one of the biggest criminal cases in Germany’s history, when a 100kg Canadian gold coin known as ‘Big Maple Leaf’ was stolen from Berlin’s Bode Museum in 2017. The story, directed by Jan Zabeil, follows the investigation into the audacious heist, the legal proceedings and prosecutor Katrin Faust’s cat-and-mouse struggle with perpetrators, but is considered humorous and light-hearted at times as the absurdity of the situation is revealed. Members of the Remmo family, an influential Mhallami-Arab group in Berlin whose image is fueled by rap and film, were ultimately convicted of the robbery and the doc looks closely at them. Beetz restructure For the Leonine Studios-owned Beetz, which is known for docs such as Sundance doc Eternal You , the launch of Clangold comes after it restructured this year under six genre labels. Christian Beetz and Georg Tschurtschenthaler Beetz Brothers Premium content arm Beetz Originals was responsible for Clangold . The others are Elon Musk Unveiled – The Tesla Experiment producer Beetz Investigate; Wacken – Hearts Full of Metal maker Beetz Music; Beetz Sports, which is making a film about World Cup winner turned extreme sports competitor André Schürrle; The First Lady maker Beetz Queer; and Beetz Factual, which made Trump’s America . Tschurtschenthaler and Beetz said this was partly in response to a belief the market is becoming increasingly commercial just as the film festivals that have traditionally underpinned their business model chase artistic movies. “We had an internal debate about how to position ourselves, and we arrived at the phrase, ‘We want to entertain — entertainment that resonates,'” said Beetz, who launched the company with his brother Reinhardt 26 years ago. “In contrast to some other projects, we add complexity and depth because we think there is a big audience that wants to be entertained but also wants to learn something,” added Tschurtschenthaler. “That was the core of Clangold . It is a heist story, so but have reinvented the crime genre a little – it is very funny and the first episode is really entertaining, but a second layer goes deeper into the controversial topics of organized crime, migration and integration.” He added the restructure was also based on expertize within the company. “In this more challenging market you need to be outstanding with every project,” he said, while Beetz added the global streamers’ focus on entertainment meant, “Every click counts and that is where the money is.” Beetz estimated his company has won in excess of 150 awards, but has shifted focus away from the likes of IDFA and Sundance to the International Emmys and other ceremonies that are “closer to the market” in 2026. “This is a substantial change,” added Tschurtschenthaler “In the old days – maybe three to five years ago – having a film in competition at Sundance would automatically trigger sales and bring in a large audience. That is not the case anymore. The digital world works differently, and that has led to a fairly drastic change in our strategy.” 2027 plans Upcoming projects include ZDF doc Countdown to the Midterms , which follows how the race for Congress is shaping up on both sides, with analysis from the likes of Tucker Carlson, Phil Murphy and Karen Attiah. German filmmaker Marcel Mettelsiefen is directing the Beetz Factual show. Vienna , meanwhile, is a Beetz Original that goes inside the story of Taylor Swift’s three canceled concerts in the Austrian capital in August 2024 after intelligence was received about a planned terror attack by a teenager who was radicalized through TikTok. “We have the USP of Taylor Swift and the breaking-news element, but we are telling the inside story and exploring the relevance of a new type of Islamic terrorist — digital terrorists who do not necessarily speak Arabic or appear particularly religious,” said Tschurtschenthaler. “The story ultimately connects to the manosphere. At the end of the day, these are lost kids. Some move toward the right and some move in other directions.” The company’s Elon Musk doc, which looks into the alleged failure of the billionaire’s Tesla company to address concerns over deadly faults with the autopilot function of its self-driving cars, sold widely earlier this year . Kaleidoscope has the rights in the U.S., UK and Ireland, with Mediawan Rights selling it elsewhere. Mediawan, the French group that bought Beetz parent Leonine in 2024, has been looking at how its production assets can work together to fund projects. The company made news last month when it teamed with Reese Witherspoon to buy her Hello Sunshine business from Candle Media, adding it to a lineup also including Brad Pitt’s Plan B Entertainment and Slow Horses producer See-Saw Films. Beetz chuckled at the idea of co-producing with Witherspoon, but said the bigger focus was identifying its own IP that could work internationally as scripted projects. “Then we can bring them together with the right people from the fiction side,” he added. Elsinore earned nominations for Best British Independent Film, Best Director for Simon Stone, Best Screenplay for Simon Beresford, Best Lead Performance for previous winner Andrew Scott, and Best Supporting Performance for Billie Piper. The film also received seven craft nominations, including Best Cinematography, Best Casting, Best Costume Design, Best Editing, Best Make-Up & Hair Design for Nadia Stacey, Best Original Music, and Best Production Design for Helen Scott. articles.title: France Opens War Crimes Investigation Into Beirut Deaths Of Artist-Filmmaker Ali Cherri’s Parents
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Melanie Goodfellow Melanie Goodfellow Senior International Film Correspondent @mel_goodfellow More Stories By Melanie France Opens War Crimes Investigation Into Beirut Deaths Of Artist-Filmmaker Ali Cherri’s Parents Josh Hartnett, Emma Thompson, Sally Hawkins, Danny Huston, Robert Aramayo & Chloe Pirrie Join Elle Fanning & Julianne Moore In Rebecca Miller’s ‘Moonsong: A Life In Seven Verses’ – AFM ‘Who Is Still Alive’ Trailer: Watermelon Pictures Sets U.S. Theatrical Release For Swiss Oscar Entry View All November 3, 2026 4:27am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Photo of a young Ali Cherri and his parents retrieved from the rubble of their bombed apartment building Ali Cherri The French War Crimes Unit has opened a judicial investigation into the Israeli army’s bombing of a residential building in Beirut in November 2024 in which seven civilians were killed, including the parents of Franco-Lebanese artist Ali Cherri . Related Stories News Neon Joins Yuval Abraham & Rachel Szor’s Explosive Gaza-Israel Doc ‘NAZA’ News International Insider: Votes Cast In Israel & Brazil; Tokyo Drift; Domingo Corral Interview The decision comes six months after Cherri, who is known in the film world for his Cannes Directors’ Fortnight-selected feature The Dam, and the Paris-based International Federation for Human Rights (FIDH) filed an official complaint to the unit about the incident. The case concerns the Israeli military’s bombing of a residential building in Beirut on November 26, 2024, just a few hours before a ceasefire agreement between Israel and Hezbollah was due to come into effect. The strike destroyed three floors of the apartment block with Cherri’s father and mother, Mahmoud Naim Cherri and Nadira Hayek, as well as a domestic worker employed by the couple, Birki Negesa, among the seven civilians who were killed. Watch on Deadline Two investigating judges from the French War Crimes Unit have been appointed to investigate the case. “To our knowledge, this is the very first judicial investigation opened into the crimes committed by the Israeli army in Lebanon since October 2023,” said Clémence Bectarte, lawyer and coordinator of the FIDH Litigation Action Group. “We hope that this investigation will shed full light on the bombing of 26 November 2024, which we qualified as a war crime in our complaint.” Cherri, who divides his time between Paris and Beirut, is one of Lebanon’s best-known contemporary artists, whose work has shown at the Guggenheim, Tate Modern and the Jeu de Paume among many other galleries. As he holds dual French and Lebanese nationality, the judicial investigation will focus only on the bombing of his apartment. The French courts do not have jurisdiction over the events that led to the deaths of the victims, who were not French nationals. “The opening of this judicial investigation marks another important step in our fight against impunity and our struggle for justice for those who were killed. For my family and me, it is essential that this investigation establish responsibility and ensure that those who ordered and carried out this bombing are held accountable for their actions.” said Cherri. Tensions between Israel and militant group Hezbollah ratcheted up in 2023 when the latter intensified attacks along Israel’s northern border in the wake of the October 7 Hamas attacks on the south of the country. Israel launched a military campaign in Lebanon in September 2024, involving aerial bombardments and a ground invasion, which killed more than 4,000 people and displaced another one million inhabitants. The Israeli military has been accused of targeting buildings in Lebanon in a bid to take out Hezbollah militant operatives in full knowledge that civilians would also be caught in the strike. A fragile ceasefire has been in place since November 2024, with the Israeli army still occupying parts of southern Lebanon and sporadic skirmishes. articles.title: Lucky Number Unveils First Image Of Hiam Abbass In Psychological Thriller ‘Daughter Of Eden’ – AFM
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Melanie Goodfellow Melanie Goodfellow Senior International Film Correspondent @mel_goodfellow More Stories By Melanie Lucky Number Unveils First Image Of Hiam Abbass In Psychological Thriller ‘Daughter Of Eden’ – AFM France Opens War Crimes Investigation Into Beirut Deaths Of Artist-Filmmaker Ali Cherri’s Parents Josh Hartnett, Emma Thompson, Sally Hawkins, Danny Huston, Robert Aramayo & Chloe Pirrie Join Elle Fanning & Julianne Moore In Rebecca Miller’s ‘Moonsong: A Life In Seven Verses’ – AFM View All November 3, 2026 5:00am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Daughter of Eden © Flower Market Films Ltd, Newgrange Pictures Limited, British Broadcasting Corporation, The British Film Institute 2026 EXCLUSIVE: Lucky Number has released a first image of Succession star Hiam Abbass in London-set psychological thriller Daughter of Eden , in which she plays a woman suspected of having connections with the Saddam Hussein regime in a past life. The Paris-based sales company is gearing up for an AFM sales launch for the debut feature of Iranian British director Ahmadi, after buzzy shorts including the BIFA nominated Bitter Sea and Leila’s Blues which screened at Cannes Directors’ Fortnight as part of Tunisia Factory. The cast also features Yasmin Al-Khudhairi ( ( A Good Girl’s Guide to Murder ), Amir El-Masry ( Giant ) and Lindsay Duncan ( Birdman ). Related Stories Casting Jeremy Renner & Josh Brolin Set For Orlando von Einsiedel's 'A Speck In The Sea'; 193 Launching Sales At AFM News Josh Hartnett, Emma Thompson, Sally Hawkins, Danny Huston, Robert Aramayo & Chloe Pirrie Join Elle Fanning & Julianne Moore In Rebecca Miller's 'Moonsong: A Life In Seven Verses' - AFM Al-Khudhairi stars as British Iraqi nurse who begins to suspect that one of her patients may be connected to the fate of her parents under Saddam Hussein’s rule in Iraq. Watch on Deadline Driven by a desperate need to uncover the truth about her family’s past, she becomes increasingly entangled in the life of her patient, as her search for answers threatens to consume her and blur the line between justice and revenge. Beyond its psychological thriller premise, Daughter of Eden explores the lasting trauma of political persecution and the legacy of violence across generations. “Daughter of Eden began with a question I kept coming back to: how far might someone go for justice when the past still feels painfully present? I wanted to explore the pain that can stay with a person long after the violence itself has ended,” said Ahmadi. The film is produced by Jack Tarling of Shudder Films ( Kneecap , God’s Own Country ) and Pietro Greppi of Lunapark Pictures ( Flux Gourmet ) in co-production with Jackie Larkin of Newgrange Pictures. It is funded by the BFI (awarding National Lottery funding) and BBC Film, in association with Screen Ireland, Civic Studios and Three Point Capital (TPC), with the BFI and BBC Film having previously developed the project. “We are very excited to be working on Fateme Ahmadi’s debut feature, a compelling psychological thriller that builds an unsettling sense of tension and uncertainty, drawing audiences deeper into its world until the very end,” said Lucky Number. “ Daughter of Eden skilfully revisits the perpetrator–victim relationship by taking a careful and in-depth look at the psychology of its characters, reflecting on the uncomfortable questions and exploring the lasting consequences of trauma and political violence.” Lucky Number will be screening a first promo-reel for the film at the AFM. “We’re excited to partner with Lucky Number to give an exclusive first glimpse of the film to distributors at AFM whilst we make the finishing touches,” said Tarling and Greppi. Lucky Number was launched by Olivier Barbier, Ola Byszuk and Lenny Porte in 2024 with a focus on ambitious French and international auteur films with a global appeal. Remaining true to its founding mission, its 2026 slate has featured Berlinale Perspectives title Where To? By Assaf Machnes; Cannes Un Certain Regard selection Strawberries by Laïla Marrakchi, which is Morocco’s 2027 Oscars entry; Directors’ Fortnight selected Death Has No Master by Jorge Thielen Armand, which is Venezuela’s entry, and Jacqueline Lentzou’s Venice Orizzonti Best Director winner Day in the Life of Jo: Chapter Phaedra . articles.title: UK Theme Park Alton Towers Permanently Closes David Walliams Attraction
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Jake Kanter Jake Kanter International Investigations Editor @Jake_Kanter More Stories By Jake British Star Loses Bid To Stop ITN & Guardian Publishing Sexual Misconduct Allegations UK Theme Park Alton Towers Permanently Closes David Walliams Attraction ‘The Celebrity Traitors’ Star James Acaster Trashes Report That He Made Complaint About Co-Stars View All November 3, 2026 5:00am Add us as a Google Preferred Source David Walliams Merlin Entertainments The World of David Walliams , an attraction at British theme park Alton Towers, is shutting up shop. The Merlin Entertainments-owned park said it would permanently close the Walliams-themed attraction after it opened in 2021, bringing to life characters from his books, such as Gangsta Granny. Related Stories News The 65 Movies That Have Made More Than $1 Billion At The Global Box Office News Oscars: Every Best Picture Winner Back To The Beginning In 1929 A Merlin Entertainments spokesperson told Deadline: “As the 2026 peak season at Alton Towers Resort comes to an end and following our regular review of rides and attractions across the resort, we have taken the decision to permanently close the World of David Walliams.” Merlin Entertainments did not elaborate, but it is understood that the company took a range of operational and guest experience factors into consideration. Walliams’ literary agent at Independent Talent has been approached for comment. Watch on Deadline The closure follows Walliams’ publisher, HarperCollins, dropping the author and halting the publication of his back catalog following misconduct allegations. Walliams strongly denied wrongdoing after accusations about his behavior were published in The Daily Telegraph last year. Separately, Deadline revealed in September that YMU is no longer actively representing the comedian and his profile has been removed from the agency’s website. A source said Walliams “is not currently in a commercial relationship with YMU” following amicable talks in early 2026. Walliams is an established presence on British television and beyond, having created and co-starred in Little Britain with Matt Lucas in the noughties. They have made attempts to revive the BBC comedy and even spoke to Netflix about a new series in 2020. Walliams has appeared in series, including Doctor Who and Agatha Christie adaptation Partners in Crime , and had roles in movies including Murder Mystery and Stardust . He served as a judge on Britain’s Got Talent for a decade alongside Simon Cowell, but left the show under a cloud after comments he made about contestants were leaked to The Guardian in 2022. In one example, he called someone a “c***.” Walliams later apologized for his comments. articles.title: British Star Loses Bid To Stop ITN & Guardian Publishing Sexual Misconduct Allegations
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Jake Kanter Jake Kanter International Investigations Editor @Jake_Kanter More Stories By Jake British Star Loses Bid To Stop ITN & Guardian Publishing Sexual Misconduct Allegations UK Theme Park Alton Towers Permanently Closes David Walliams Attraction ‘The Celebrity Traitors’ Star James Acaster Trashes Report That He Made Complaint About Co-Stars View All November 3, 2026 6:45am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Getty Images A well-known British man has lost his bid for an injunction against ITN and The Guardian to prevent the media outlets from publishing allegations of sexual misconduct. In a High Court judgment, the star’s claim for an injunction was denied, but a temporary order preventing the man (known as PPT in court proceedings) from being named remains in place pending an appeal. Related Stories News The 65 Movies That Have Made More Than $1 Billion At The Global Box Office News Oscars: Every Best Picture Winner Back To The Beginning In 1929 The case has generated significant interest in the UK, sparking widespread social media speculation about the identity of the man at the heart of the allegations. “The claimant’s claim for an injunction was dismissed,” said Mr Justice Nicklin in a judgment Tuesday, per BBC and Sky News. Watch on Deadline “The court did not determine whether the allegations, or any of them, were true, and the dismissal of the claim does not amount to approval of any publication the defendants may decide to make.” During a hearing, PPT’s legal team argued that publishing would be “highly likely” to lead to his death by suicide after he had made two previous attempts to take his own life. Gavin Millar, who made the case for ITN and The Guardian , argued that the news organizations had a duty to publish information that was in the public interest. The two outlets are seeking to publish allegations of inappropriate and exploitative sexual activities with girls and young women based on the accounts of more than 30 sources, The Guardian reported. In a written submission to the court, PPT’s lawyers said: “It is important to understand that this drastic effect on the claimant is not from guilt of the wrongdoing alleged (which is denied) but because of shame arising from deep-rooted childhood trauma and the fear of ‘trial by media.'” The court heard that PPT had made two previous attempts to kill himself: In May, when ITN and The Guardian gave him an opportunity to respond to the allegations; and in July, when he absconded from a secure hospital. ITN is the British news group behind ITV News, Channel 4 News, and Skydance’s 5 News. articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Melanie Goodfellow Melanie Goodfellow Senior International Film Correspondent @mel_goodfellow More Stories By Melanie Lucky Number Unveils First Image Of Hiam Abbass In Psychological Thriller ‘Daughter Of Eden’ – AFM France Opens War Crimes Investigation Into Beirut Deaths Of Artist-Filmmaker Ali Cherri’s Parents Josh Hartnett, Emma Thompson, Sally Hawkins, Danny Huston, Robert Aramayo & Chloe Pirrie Join Elle Fanning & Julianne Moore In Rebecca Miller’s ‘Moonsong: A Life In Seven Verses’ – AFM View All November 3, 2026 7:16am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Aizzah Fatima Manoli Figetakis/Getty Images EXCLUSIVE: New York State-based production, sales and distribution company The Dazey Phase has boarded Americanish creator and star Aizzah Fatima ’s feature directorial debut Miss Christian Babe as a coproducer. Set against the backdrop of Mississippi-set, coming-of-age tale Miss Christian Babe explores the experience of growing up Muslim in the American South, navigating questions of identity, faith, community and belonging. The movie builds on Fatima’s work exploring underrepresented perspectives and the complexities of Muslim identity, which began with her hit one woman play Dirty Paki Lingerie , with characters from the show then spun into Americanish . Related Stories News The Dazey Phase Boards Best Yet Entertainment Co-Founder Kareem J. Mortimer's 'House On Fire' News Tori Spelling Thriller 'Lost in The Everglades' Filming; A+E 'Alone' Indian Remake; 'Egghead & Twinkie' AFM Launch & Paramount Backs Manchester Hospital Cinema - Global Briefs Fatima who co-wrote Americanish with Iman Zawahry, who directed, also co-starred as Sam Khan, a career focused PR exec living with her equally driven sister Maryam in Queens, where they are joined by newly immigrated cousin Ameera. After a festival run, the film was acquired by Sony International. Watch on Deadline The new film taps into Fatima’s teenage experiences growing up in Mississippi before heading to New York. “I grew up Muslim in small-town Mississippi so obviously that meant church on Sundays and pageants on Saturdays. It was absurd, and it was home. I’d never seen that world on screen, and am thrilled to bring it to life,” said Fatima. The Dazey Phase’s co-head Jake Casey ( Hallowarrior ) and Head of Business and Strategy Danielle Benedict ( Heightened Scrutiny ) are on board as producers alongside Rohi Mirza Pandya ( Hiding Divya ). Mirza Pandya, one of the founders of Box Office Guru Media , brings more than two decades of experience in film marketing, audience strategy and championing culturally resonant stories. “I’m excited to partner with Aizzah and The Dazey Phase on a story that brings a fresh perspective to the screen,” she said. “ Miss Christian Babe has the opportunity to connect with audiences through its distinctive cultural lens and its deeply human themes.” Founded by Syracuse, New York natives Jake and Eva Casey, The Dazey Phase focuses on inclusive and responsible storytelling from a unique perspective, with recent projects including Hallowarrior (Shudder), Heightened Scrutiny (Sundance 2025) and Desire Lines (Sundance 2024). “I’m thrilled to help bring Aizzah’s vision to life. Her storytelling is something that really excites me; it’s vivid, specific, and personal,” said Jake Casey. Something’s In There was written and directed by Joel Harber. The film is described as a supernatural horror thriller. It also stars Peter Gold and Elsie Hewitt, with Raoul Max Trujillo ( Apocalypto ), Rob Moran, Paul Ben-Victor, Jayson Warner Smith ( The Walking Dead ), and Alexander Kane. Synopsis reads: Aspiring filmmaker Billy Hobbs takes a night-watchman job at a film studio, where strange sights, sounds, and deaths blur the line between his favorite horror films and reality. He must uncover what is happening before becoming the next victim. Related Stories News Lucky Number Unveils First Image Of Hiam Abbass In Psychological Thriller 'Daughter Of Eden' - AFM Casting Jeremy Renner & Josh Brolin Set For Orlando von Einsiedel's 'A Speck In The Sea'; 193 Launching Sales At AFM The other Catalytic Films titles are: Watch on Deadline Boundaries — Directed by Kirandeep Karnati, the uplifting ensemble drama follows predominantly South Asian women in suburban California who form a cricket team. Challenging cultural expectations and personal limitations, they discover friendship, independence, and solidarity through sport. Paper Flowers — Directed by Mahesh Pailoor (Brahmin Bulls) and produced by Asit Vyas (Zara Si Bhool), the inspirational drama follows USC graduate Shalin Shah, who leaves his Indian American family and Taiwanese American girlfriend to volunteer with the Peace Corps. A rare cancer diagnosis forces him home, where he finds new meaning in love, gratitude, and the time he has left. Kapil Talwalkar (Night Court), Olivia Liang (Kung Fu), Karan Soni (Deadpool), Tom Everett Scott (That Thing You Do!), Faran Tahir (Iron Man) and Meera Simhan (Four Samosas) star. The film earned recognition at Palm Springs, San Luis Obispo, Sedona, and Chandler film festivals. North American viewers can watch Paper Flowers on the Angel Studios streaming service. Catalytic Films is licensing the remaining worldwide rights. We Are Never Alone — Directed and scored by Michel Pascal and produced by Stephen Powers, the docudrama explores human connection, spirituality and music through stories of healing and hope, featuring Michael Beckwith, Gabriella Wright and Temple Hayes. Catalytic will also arrive at AFM with a “strategic alliance” with Unni Rav’s Visual Narrative Films (VNF). articles.title: BBC Top Brass “Looking At Options” For Next Phase Of $400 Million Worth Of Savings, Says Deputy DG
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Max Goldbart Max Goldbart International TV Co-Editor @Goldbart1 More Stories By Max BBC Top Brass “Looking At Options” For Next Phase Of $400 Million Worth Of Savings, Says Deputy DG New Anti-Harassment Laws Lead To Questions From UK Film & TV Industry John Leeson Dies: Actor Who Voiced Iconic Role In ‘Doctor Who’ Was 83 View All November 3, 2026 8:00am Add us as a Google Preferred Source 'The Celebrity Traitors' BBC/Studio Lambert The BBC ’s top brass is in the process of “looking at options for the next stage of savings,” according to the Deputy Director General, which will total another £300M ($400M). Rhodri Talfan Davies said it is very unlikely another big savings announcement will come before Christmas but stressed that the “lion’s share” of the cash has to be found before the end of the current BBC charter in 2027/28. He said these conversations are currently taking place at the very upper echelons of the broadcaster. “The executive senior team is now looking at options for the next stage of savings,” Talfan Davies told journalists at a Broadcasting Press Guild lunch. “We haven’t yet shared those with the [wider] team because we’re still working through them. There are lots of ideas on the table, but until the Executive Committee reaches a decision, there’s nothing to announce.” Related Stories News 'Blue Eye Samurai' Sets Season 2 Release Date At Netflix News Jason Statham & Guy Ritchie Reunite For Netflix Feature 'Dogfight' Talfan Davies was interim Director General in April when the BBC announced it was laying off 2,000 people. Since then, his new boss Matt Brittin, the permanent DG, has been busily enacting the £500M savings plan, a tricky task in the funding climate. Around £200M has been found so far. Watch on Deadline Last month, the BBC made the long-awaited announcement that it would be shutting youth-skewing linear network BBC Three along with the BBC Scotland channel and Radio 4 Extra. Our analysis spotlighted how the worst is to come and floated that speculation internally has turned to the future of radio and podcast streamer BBC Sounds. Today, Talfan Davies gave press a window into the corporation’s thinking around Sounds and VoD platform BBC iPlayer, which is in the process of being transformed. “The real question – and I don’t know the answer – is whether iPlayer will be more and more the home for some of our biggest audio brands,” he speculated. “But you’ll still need a strongly creative collection of all your services. Brands come and go, but there will be a home for BBC audio content and its listeners.” The BBC remains unsure over its future funding model as charter negotiations with the government continue and Talfan Davies said the corporation is in the meantime having to “ride two horses in terms of financial outcomes, which is not ideal.” The main funding solution to have emerged so far appears to be the so-called “ Netflix tax,” which would force streaming service subs to pay the £180 annual license fee as it desperately tries to get more audiences to pay the fee. With Netflix in a tight spot having just laid off 1,000 staff itself, Talfan Davies acknowledged that the streamers “might not be supportive” of the proposal but said “in some ways it’s not a million miles” from yesteryear. He was referring to a time when audiences in the UK had to pay the fee even if they only watched other linear TV channels. “There are echoes of that reform in what has been suggested,” said Talfan Davies. Case against Donald Trump “very strong” Donald Trump Photo by Roberto Schmidt/Getty Images On the day of the U.S. midterms, and with Republicans expected to be inflicted with heavy defeats, Talfan Davies addressed the $10B defamation lawsuit the BBC faces from Donald Trump. While saying he is “not in the business of second-guessing judges,” Talfan Davies said the BBC’s case to have the defamation suit thrown out of a Florida court over jurisdiction is “very strong.” “We’ve put our best foot forward in setting out the arguments about why we don’t think it should be heard in the U.S. at all,” he said. “I would like the judge to agree.” The situation emerged when a BBC Panorama show made a botched edit of Trump’s Jan. 6 speech that appeared to show him inciting insurrection. Talfan Davies, who as Deputy DG now oversees the editorial standards and legal teams, said “a lot has changed” internally since the error was made and the “sluggishness” of the BBC’s response was “probably more profound” than the error with the package itself. He stressed the BBC has introduced “‘before final gate’ processes for our most contentious programmes” that sees key people involved “go through a programme line by line.” He caveatted by saying “anyone in my job who says there won’t be future issues in an organization is being naive.” “The BBC does big investigations,” he added. “I’m not naive about that. But I do think the processes and controls we’ve put in place have made us much stronger.” Disney To Undergo More Layoffs With 20% Divisional Cost Savings Eyed Jason Statham & Guy Ritchie Reunite For Netflix Feature ‘Dogfight’ Boost California Tax Incentive To $1 Billion-Plus ASAP, Exiting Governor Says ‘Elsinore’ Leads British Independent Film Awards Nominations Read More About: Comments

Also new to cast are Lonzo Liggins ( Yellowstone ), comedian John Novosad and Denzel Papillon. The eight-episode half-hour addiction-themed dramedy is now in production in Utah starring Craig Ferguson and Megyn Price. The series will be distributed by Angel. Craig Ferguson stars as Nick McTavers and Megyn Price stars as Liza. In Quitters , “after Liza, an upbeat soccer mom, falls into the cycle of opioid addiction, she lands at Unplugged, an unconventional recovery center run by Nick McTavers, a former heavy-metal legend. To put her life back on track, Liza must learn to rely on an eclectic family of patients and counselors who help her navigate the long road of recovery.” Watch on Deadline Related Stories News Craig Ferguson & Megyn Price Starring In Addiction Dramedy Series 'Quitters' For Angel News BBC Top Brass "Looking At Options" For Next Phase Of $400 Million Worth Of Savings, Says Deputy DG Lennon will play Brian, Liza’s husband, “caught between love for his family and the limits of what he can endure as her addiction takes hold”. Rickards will play Mallory, “a tough-talking young patient whose combative, complicated relationship with Liza unfolds over the season, as she wages her own hard fight toward recovery.” Handler will play Chloe, Liza and Brian’s teenage daughter, “whose arc turns from teenage humor to something far more raw as her mother’s addiction closes in.” Tristan Whitman serves as director of photography, Eric Wilson as production designer, and Jayme Bohn as costume designer on the series. The series is directed by Darrin “Fletch” Fletcher and Chet Thomas and produced through their FletChet Entertainment banner, and was written and created by Dave Parkin. Executive producers include Chet Thomas, Darrin Fletcher, Eric Handler, Chase Vergari, Ibrahim Mohammed, Dave Parkin, Edward Neumeier, Rob Gibbs, HR Brown and Alema Harrington. “This ensemble is everything we hoped for,” said Fletch and Chet. “Every role has been cast with someone who brings real heart and humor to it, on both sides of this story — the recovery center and the families whose lives it touches. Watching it all come to life has been a joy, and we can’t wait for audiences to meet these characters.” Lennon is represented by UTA, Artists First, and Jackoway Austen Tyerman. Rickards is represented by Alchemy Entertainment, Play Management, and IAG. Handler is represented by 3 Arts Entertainment. Liggins is represented by Love Talent Agency, Susan McCarty Agency, and Outlaw Artist Management. Novosad is represented by Comedy Works Entertainment. Papillon is represented by Love Talent Agency. articles.title: Russell Brand Trial: Jury Begins Verdict Deliberations
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Jake Kanter Jake Kanter International Investigations Editor @Jake_Kanter More Stories By Jake British Star Loses Bid To Stop ITN & Guardian Publishing Sexual Misconduct Allegations UK Theme Park Alton Towers Permanently Closes David Walliams Attraction ‘The Celebrity Traitors’ Star James Acaster Trashes Report That He Made Complaint About Co-Stars View All November 3, 2026 8:10am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Russell Brand Getty Russell Brand ‘s rape trial has concluded and the jury has begun deliberations on a verdict. After more than three weeks of evidence, the jury will now consider whether to convict or acquit Brand of seven charges: three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault, and one count of attempted indecent assault. The latter was reduced from indecent assault during the trial. Brand has pleaded not guilty to all charges. Related Stories News The 65 Movies That Have Made More Than $1 Billion At The Global Box Office News Oscars: Every Best Picture Winner Back To The Beginning In 1929 A verdict will not be returned on Tuesday after Judge Mr Justice Bennathan sent the jury home at 4PM local time. He told jurors to “resist talking about the case” until they are all gathered again on Wednesday morning. The judge spent much of the day summarizing the evidence for the jury, going through each charge in detail. This followed closing arguments from the prosecution and defense. Watch on Deadline In legal directions last week, the judge told the jury that they are not under pressure to reach a swift verdict. “No jury can be criticized for taking too little or too much time in their deliberations, you alone must decide on that,” he told them. Bennathan said the jury must reach unanimous verdicts on each of the charges to convict Brand. He reminded jurors last week that the burden of proof is on the prosecution and that Brand is entitled to the benefit of the doubt. In legal directions to the jury last week, Bennathan also told the jury to disregard the 2023 Channel 4 documentary that carried allegations about Brand when coming to their decision. “Do not think that a few women making anonymous complaints in a TV show adds any support at all to the prosecution,” he said at the time. “The defendant denied the allegations [in the documentary] in robust, detailed terms. They were never tested in any court.” Both the prosecution and defense discussed the documentary at length during their closing arguments. articles.title: Netflix Acquires Joel Coen’s ‘Jack of Spades,’ Planning Big Push for Next Oscar Season
articles.full_text: × Skip to main content By Scott Feinberg Plus Icon Scott Feinberg Executive Editor of Awards ScottFeinberg Follow Sign Up View All November 2, 2026 9:00am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Joel Coen Stephane Cardinale - Corbis/Corbis via Getty Images Netflix has a full plate for this Oscar season — its contenders include La Bola Negra , 14th , Possible Love , Ray Gunn , Ink , Gentle Monster , The Mosquito Bowl , Avedon and In Waves — but that hasn’t stopped the streamer from making plans for next Oscar season, as well. The streamer has acquired the worldwide distribution rights to Joel Coen ’s next directorial outing, Jack of Spades , which is based on Frances Frederica Montrésor’s 1901 novel The Alien: A Story of Middle Age and is being described as “a sinister gothic mystery filled with intrigue and betrayal set in the atmospheric Scottish Highlands.” The film, which wrapped production earlier this year, will be released in theaters in fall 2027 ahead of its release on the platform. And the company sees it as a major awards prospect. Related Stories TV Druski Signs Deal With Netflix, Sets Church Comedy 'Collect & Praise' Business Netflix Layoffs Hit U.K., With VP, Production Anna Mallett Among 2-3 Percent of Staff Affected The film stars the 36-year-old Olivier Award winner Patsy Ferran , as well as Golden Globe winner Josh O’Connor, Golden Globe winner Damian Lewis and Oscar nominee Lesley Manville . Joel Coen wrote it with his brother Ethan (both won multiple Oscars for 2007’s No Country for Old Men ), as well as Eleanor Catton and Conor McPherson; and produced it with his wife, Frances McDormand (who won an Oscar for producing 2020’s Nomadland , and also was a producer on her husband’s 2021 film The Tragedy of Macbeth ), as well as Indian Paintbrush’s Steven Rales, Blueprint Pictures’ Graham Broadbent and Peter Czernin, and Robert Graf. The film’s crew includes numerous frequent collaborators of Joel Coen, among them cinematographer Bruno Delbonnel (2013’s Inside Llewyn Davis , The Tragedy of Macbeth and 2018’s The Ballad of Buster Scruggs ) and composer Carter Burwell (1984’s Blood Simple , 1987’s Raising Arizona , 1990’s Miller’s Crossing , 1991’s Barton Fink , 1994’s The Hudsucker Proxy , 1996’s Fargo , 1998’s The Big Lebowski , 2000’s O Brother, Where Art Thou? , 2001’s The Man Who Wasn’t There , 2003’s Intolerable Cruelty , 2004’s The Ladykillers , No Country for Old Men , 2008’s Burn After Reading , 2009’s A Serious Man , 2010’s True Grit , 2016’s Hail, Caesar! , The Ballad of Buster Scruggs and The Tragedy of Macbeth ). Jack of Spades marks a reunion between Netflix and Joel Coen following The Ballad of Buster Scruggs , which landed three Oscar noms, including best adapted screenplay for the Coen brothers; and between Netflix and Josh O’Connor following The Crown (2019-2020) and 2025’s Wake Up Dead Man . The Coen brothers are represented by UTA and attorney Pat Murphy. UTA represented the sale. THR

articles.title: Paul Anka, David Foster, Andy Garcia, David Mamet and Barbara Mandrell Set for Kennedy Center Honors
articles.full_text: × Skip to main content By Etan Vlessing Plus Icon Etan Vlessing Canada Bureau Chief View All November 2, 2026 9:00am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Paul Anka, David Foster, Andy Garcia, David Mamet and Barbara Mandrell JC Olivera/Getty Images; Phillip Faraone/Getty Images; Rodin Eckenroth/Getty Images; Ernesto Ruscio/Getty Images; Larry McCormack/Variety/Getty Images The latest honorees for the revamped Kennedy Center Honors have been unveiled. This year’s honorees are singers Paul Anka and Barbara Mandrell, composer David Foster, actor Andy Garcia and writer David Mamet, it was announced on Monday. The latest Kennedy Center Honors will take place at Capital One Arena in Washington, D.C. The Kennedy Center itself has been at the center of a legal battle as U.S. President Donald Trump slammed a court decision to block his name, twice, from being added to the building’s exterior. The board at the arts institution also chose to shut down the Kennedy Center, with Trump in social media posts suggesting the closure would allow future renovations. Related Stories Music Bryan Adams Releases New Trump Protest Song "Lake Ontario" Music Neil Young Sues Trump for Using "Rockin' in the Free World" at Rally: "The Opposite of Everything Donald J. Trump Stands For" Launched in 1978, the annual Kennedy Center Honors event recognizes individuals who have made lifetime contributions to American culture through the performing arts. “We are recognizing amazing artists whose lifelong work has shaped American culture and inspired generations of audiences. We are proud to honor this year’s class and to continue a tradition that has defined the Center for nearly 50 years,” Trump said in a statement. There’s no word on whether Trump will again host the 2026 Kennedy Center Honors event. The ratings for the 2025 Kennedy Center Honors, hosted by Trump at the Kennedy Center, dropped to a new all-time low. Last year’s honors gala aired on CBS and Paramount+ amid news of Trump’s plans to rename the Kennedy Center to The Donald J. Trump and The John F. Kennedy Memorial Center for the Performing Arts. The push to rename the arts institution has drawn blowback, including by members of the Kennedy family and resulted in numerous artists dropping out of planned performance at the Kennedy Center. THR

articles.title: Golden Globes: ‘Club Kid’ Submitted as Drama (Exclusive)
articles.full_text: × Skip to main content By Scott Feinberg Plus Icon Scott Feinberg Executive Editor of Awards ScottFeinberg Follow Sign Up View All November 2, 2026 9:40am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Jordan Firstman and Reggie Absolom in 'Club Kid' Courtesy of A24 Club Kid , Jordan Firstman ’s acclaimed film about a club promoter who stays too long at the party, has been submitted by distributor A24 for Golden Globes consideration as a drama, rather than a musical/comedy, The Hollywood Reporter has exclusively learned. This classification means that the film — which Firstman wrote, directed (as his feature directorial debut) and stars in — will compete in the genre-specific Globes categories (picture, actor and actress) against the likes of The Odyssey , La Bola Negra , Dune: Part Three , Elsinore , All of a Sudden , Fjord and Possible Love , rather than Wild Horse Nine , The Invite , The Debut , Artificial , Obsession , Project Hail Mary and Tender Loving Care . Related Stories General News 2026 Daytime Emmy Awards: 'General Hospital' Wins Best Daytime Drama TV The Hollywood Reporter Wins 2026 Daytime Emmy Award A24’s decision, which was made in close consultation with Firstman, may come as a surprise to some given Firstman’s background in comedy and the fact that some have described Club Kid as an elevated variation of Big Daddy , the 1999 Adam Sandler comedy about a man who unexpectedly becomes the guardian of a young child. But Club Kid becomes considerably more dramatic as it progresses, and Firstman — who shines in a decidedly dramatic courtroom scene late in the film — has cited heavier films like 1978’s An Unmarried Woman and 1979’s Kramer vs. Kramer as key inspirations. Club Kid had its world premiere at the Cannes Film Festival in the Un Certain Regard section, after which it received a seven-minute standing ovation and sparked an overnight bidding war among distributors. The film ultimately sold to A24 for $17 million, making it the biggest sale of the fest. It has since played to raves at the Telluride, Toronto, New York and other film fests. And it will begin a platform theatrical release on Friday. THR recently broke the news of two other high-profile Globes categorizations: Obsession as a musical/comedy and Artificial as a musical/comedy . THR

articles.full_text: × Skip to main content By Etan Vlessing Plus Icon Etan Vlessing Canada Bureau Chief View All November 2, 2026 9:47am Add us as a Google Preferred Source 'Ceremony' smayaykila-films Netflix has nabbed the Indigenous feature documentary Ceremony after a SXSW world premiere. Director Bianchi Hanuse’s film will land on the streamer in 2027 after winning awards at SXSW, Hot Docs and the Sydney Film Festival. Ceremony centers on British Columbia’s Nuxalk Nation as it looks to restore the local population of ooligan fish, whose arrival every spring sustains the First Nations community and its ritual celebrations. The restoration efforts, including broadcasts from the Nuxalk Radio station, also underline the resilience of the Indigenous community in the face of challenges from climate change and colonialization. “Nuxalkmc [Nuxalk people] asked for this story to be told and that responsibility took 12 years because our truth isn’t an easy one to tell. It’s a story most Canadians have never heard. We made it for us and with Netflix, we’re sharing it beyond our valley,” director Hanuse said in a statement. Related Stories Movies Netflix Acquires Joel Coen's 'Jack of Spades,' Planning Big Push for Next Oscar Season TV Druski Signs Deal With Netflix, Sets Church Comedy 'Collect & Praise' In Canada , Netflix has acquired earlier Indigenous-themed or directed content, including the late Jeff Barnaby’s Rhymes for Ghouls , Stephen S. Campanelli’s Indian Horse and Miranda de Pencier’s The Grizzlies . In 2024, Netflix acquired the documentary Yintah, which follows Indigenous activists with the Wet’suwet’en First Nation looking to protect their lands and was directed by Michael Toledano, Jennifer Wickham and Brenda Mitchell. Netflix also streams the Arctic-set Indigenous comedy North of North , a co-production with the CBC. That ongoing support for Indigenous movies and creators also comes amid calls by local indie producers and other cultural nationalists for Netflix and other U.S. tech giants and foreign players to be subject to the same content expenditure obligations as traditional broadcasters. Ceremony is written by Hanuse and Jessica Mayhew and is produced by Smayaykila Films. THR

articles.title: Like, Subscribe, Graduate: Emerson College Launching Content Creation Major (Exclusive)
articles.full_text: × Skip to main content By Alex Weprin Plus Icon Alex Weprin Senior Editor alexweprin Follow Sign Up View All November 2, 2026 9:52am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Henry Winkler speaks at Emerson College's 2026 commencement ceremony in Boston. Photo by Lisa Aileen Dragani/Getty Images Communications students matriculating into Emerson College next year will have an entirely new major to choose from: A bachelor of arts in content creation. The Hollywood Reporter has learned that the Boston-based college will launch the new degree program in the fall of 2027. The new degree underscores the rapidly changing dynamics of media, with creator-led platforms like YouTube, TikTok and Instagram continuing to grow at a rapid clip even as traditional film and TV production and distribution seems to be flat or declining. The new major will pull from the school’s existing infrastructure and expertise in areas like storytelling, production and communications while incorporating creator-focused areas of study like marketing, audience development, branding and business strategy, given the owner-operator nature of the creator world. Students will develop original content while studying the business and ethics of digital platforms, while also learning how to reach and engage audiences. “Emerson has long prepared students for success in emerging creative industries with a focus on hands-on, real world application in our academic disciplines and now this new major builds on our tradition by combining creativity, technology and entrepreneurial skills for the next generation,” said Emerson president Jay Bernhardt. Emerson, which is among THR’s 25 best film schools of 2026, has an envious alumni list that includes former Warner Bros. film co-chief Pamela Abdy, filmmakers Daniel Kwan and Paul Thomas Anderson, writer Norman Lear and actors like Henry Winkler and Jennifer Coolidge. The bachelor of arts in content creation will be housed in Emerson College’s School of Communication, within the department of strategic marketing and business. “Our new content creation major prepares students to be a part of the evolving creator economy , teaching them not only how to produce compelling digital content but also how to build a successful entrepreneurial career,” said Brenna McCormick, chair of the department of strategic marketing and business. “From digital and financial literacy to business and marketing, this major has the essential ingredients to help students turn their creative visions into something bigger.” THR

articles.title: Marc Maron to Be Honored With Inaugural Richard Lewis Award at Comedy Gives Back Gala
articles.full_text: × Skip to main content By Chris Gardner Plus Icon Chris Gardner chrissgardner Follow Sign Up View All November 2, 2026 10:47am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Marc Maron attends the AFI Los Angeles premiere of 20th Century Studios' 'Springsteen: Deliver Me From Nowhere' at Hollywood's TCL Chinese Theater on Oct. 22, 2025. (Photo by Jesse Grant/Getty Images for 20th Century Studios) Comedy Gives Back — a nonprofit founded by Jodi Lieberman, Amber J. Lawson and Zoe Friedman to provide a safety net for the comedy community — is finding another way to do so by launching its first ever gala in honor of the late Richard Lewis . The Richard Lewis Humor & Humanity Gala, dubbed “a night of comedy and neurosis,” is set to take place at Hollywood Improv in Los Angeles on Nov. 15. The organization will present an inaugural trophy that night as well, also called the Richard Lewis Humor & Humanity Award, in honor of his legacy and his years-long commitment to uplifting his peers. They’ve settled on the first recipient, Marc Maron , who will be feted at the event, which will be hosted by Jeff Garlin and feature Nick Kroll as a presenter. Related Stories News Jeff Garlin Considered Suicide After Tumultuous 'Goldbergs' Exit General News Publicist Emily Vespa Joins Birch Public Relations “Richard Lewis was one of a kind. He was fearless, painfully honest and could make you laugh about the things most people are afraid to talk about. To receive an award in his name is incredibly meaningful, especially knowing it supports comedians who need help,” said Maron in a statement. Lewis, who passed away at age 76 in February 2024, was an early supporter of Comedy Gives Back and he served as a member of the org’s board. The fundraiser will host comedy and entertainment insiders while raising money for the mission of providing financial assistance, mental health resources and addiction recovery support for comedians in need. “Richard wasn’t just a comedy legend. He was our friend and an early champion of Comedy Gives Back. We couldn’t imagine a more fitting first honoree than Marc Maron. This evening is about celebrating Richard’s incredible legacy while continuing his commitment to taking care of the comedy community,” said co-founders Lieberman, Lawson and Friedman in a joint statement. Maron, a veteran stand-up and actor, launched his podcast WTF With Marc Maron in 2009. After 16 years, he stepped away to focus on other endeavors like his acting career. He stars in Stick and recently appeared in the Bruce Springsteen biopic, Deliver Me From Nowhere. Comedy Gives Back’s Richard Lewis Humor & Humanity Gala is being sponsored by HBO and the Johnny Carson Foundation. More intel can be found here . THR

articles.title: NFL and TMRW Sports’ Set ‘Premier Flag’ League Launch for Summer 2027
articles.full_text: × Skip to main content By Alex Weprin Plus Icon Alex Weprin Senior Editor alexweprin Follow Sign Up View All November 2, 2026 11:21am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Grace Amber Conway of Great Britain Photo by Pau Barrena/Getty Images The new flag football league from the NFL and TMRW Sports will officially launch next summer, and now it also has a name: Premier Flag. The league and the sports media company (which is also behind the TGL golf league) announced the new branding Monday. Premier Flag will get underway well ahead of the 2028 Olympics in Los Angeles, where the sport will be prominently featured. The NFL views flag football as a major growth engine, not only to get people interested in the full contact version of the game, but as a sport worth playing and watching in its own right. The inaugural season will be played in a purpose-built flag football stadium, the location of which is to be announced. Similarly, media rights for the first season are still being discussed, though the summer window gives it an opening, with only Major League Baseball as significant summertime competition (and a possible lockout may interrupt the next baseball season). “Flag football is exploding in popularity, and Premier Flag is establishing itself as the destination for the world’s top women and men competing at the highest level of the sport. The Premier Flag brand represents where flag football is headed – elite, global and accessible – while setting a professional standard for the sport’s growing ecosystem,” said Brendan Donohue, president of flag football for TMRW Sports. “When we launch next summer, fans will have the opportunity to see these amazing athletes perform at their best, supported by Premier Flag’s world-class training, strength and conditioning, nutrition and coaching programs.” “Premier Flag represents an exciting step forward in the continued evolution of flag football,” added Brian Flinn, NFL senior VP of global flag football. “Together with TMRW Sports, we’re building a global platform to showcase the world’s top flag football players and to engage fans in a premium experience, with the Premier Flag Showcase during Super Bowl LXI week providing an exciting first look at that vision. The launch of Premier Flag creates a new professional opportunity for the world’s best players and establishes the pinnacle of the sport’s growing global pathway.” The NFL and TMRW Sports officially announced the league earlier this year, with all 32 team owners invested alongside institutional investors and celebrity investors like Silver Lake, Ariel Investments/Project Level, Bessemer Venture Partners, Blue Pool Capital, and Dynasty Equity, as well as Tom Brady, Peyton Manning, Serena Williams, Billie Jean King, Joe Montana and Alex Morgan. In fact, Morgan’s TOGETHXR media and content company will provide social content strategy and production for the league, with Pivot Brand Group creating the brand name, positioning and visual identity of Premier Flag. THR

articles.title: ‘Obsession’ Breakout Inde Navarrette to Receive Rising Star Award at Palm Springs Film Awards (EXCLUSIVE)
articles.full_text: × Nov 2, 2026 9:20am PT ‘Obsession’ Breakout Inde Navarrette to Receive Rising Star Award at Palm Springs Film Awards (EXCLUSIVE) By Clayton Davis Plus Icon Clayton Davis Chief Awards Editor byClaytonDavis Latest John Turturro on Nearly Robbing Someone to Practice for ‘The Only Living Pickpocket in New York,’ Fighting to Save His 2005 Musical ‘Romance & Cigarettes’ and the Knicks Championship 31 minutes ago ‘Obsession’ Breakout Inde Navarrette to Receive Rising Star Award at Palm Springs Film Awards (EXCLUSIVE) 2 hours ago Joel Coen’s ‘Jack of Spades,’ With Josh O’Connor and Patsy Ferran, Lands at Netflix for Fall 2027 2 hours ago See All Add us as a Google Preferred Source Chad Salvador/Variety Inde Navarrette , the breakout star of Focus Features’ horror blockbuster “ Obsession ,” will receive the Rising Star Award at the Palm Springs International Film Awards, Variety has learned exclusively. Navarrette joins the growing list of honorees that already includes Seth Rogen, Olivia Wilde, Penélope Cruz and Edward Norton, who share the Vanguard Award for “The Invite.” The film premiered to rave reviews, holds a 94% score on Rotten Tomatoes and has grossed more than $500 million worldwide, the largest gor a Focus Features release. It recently picked up a Gotham Award nomination, and critics have consistently singled out Navarrette’s gripping and emotionally charged turn, which has put her firmly in the Oscar race for best actress. Related Stories Mediawan's Pierre-Antoine Capton on Buying Reese Witherspoon’s Hello Sunshine and Doubling Down on Hollywood Amid Consolidation (EXCLUSIVE) Apple TV's Hit German Series 'Where’s Wanda?' Returns for Season 2, Again Asking: 'How Far Would You Go to Save Your Child?' Horror has historically struggled to break through with Academy voters, but has seemingly made a positive, more inclusive turn in recent years with “The Substance,” “Sinners” and “Weapons.” A Palm Springs honor is a critical stop on the Oscar campaign trail. The Rising Star Award itself has a strong track record as an Oscar bellwether. Past recipients include Ariana Grande for “Wicked,” Timothée Chalamet for “Call Me by Your Name,” Alicia Vikander for “The Danish Girl,” Jennifer Lawrence for “Winter’s Bone,” Anna Kendrick for “Up in the Air” and Scarlett Johansson for “Lost in Translation.” Grande, Chalamet, Vikander, Lawrence and Kendrick all went on to Academy Award nominations for those performances, with Vikander taking home the supporting actress statuette. “Inde Navarrette delivers a performance in ‘Obsession’ that is impossible to look away from,” Nachhattar Singh Chandi, festival chairman says in a statement. “She brings a rare combination of emotional awareness and cinematic presence to the screen. The Rising Star Award exists to celebrate exactly this kind of breakthrough talent, and we could not be more excited to welcome Inde to Palm Springs.” Written, edited and directed by Curry Barker, the indie thriller follows Bear, a hopeless romantic who breaks the mysterious One Wish Willow to win over his crush, only to find that getting exactly what he wants comes at a sinister price. Navarrette plays Nikki Freeman opposite Michael Johnston, Megan Lawless, Cooper Tomlinson and Andy Richter. Navarrette first broke out in the fourth and final season of Netflix’s teen drama “13 Reasons Why” before landing a series regular role on The CW’s superhero drama “Superman & Lois.” She made her Sundance debut in 2020 opposite Sienna Miller and Diego Luna in “Wander Darkly.” Navarrette is set to take on the iconic role of Rogue in Marvel’s upcoming “X-Men” film and will star in and executive produce “The Waffle House Index,” a sci-fi thriller from Apple Original Films and Plan B Entertainment. articles.full_text: × Nov 2, 2026 9:48am PT Utopai Studios Names Former Disney AI Leader Hans Ku as Chief Product Officer By Corbin Bolies Plus Icon Corbin Bolies Latest Utopai Studios Names Former Disney AI Leader Hans Ku as Chief Product Officer 1 hour ago Cate Blanchett-Backed Group and Collection of Hollywood Stars File Brief in New York Times-OpenAI Lawsuit: Hollywood Has ‘Proven Infrastructure’ to License Content 3 days ago AI Vocal Modifier Voicemod Inks Disney Deal to Add Star Wars, Marvel Soundboards to Platform 3 days ago See All Add us as a Google Preferred Source Utopai Studios Utopai Studios , the AI-focused entertainment studio, has hired former Disney AI leader Hans Ku as its chief product officer, tapping a Hollywood studio veteran as the company tries to grow its content slate. Ku will focus on the studio’s product, engineering, research and business development teams, scale the startup’s AI tech and its AI production platform PAI across its film and TV slate and determine how the company builds its proprietary technology. He will report to CEO Cecilia Shen. Related Stories Appetite for Agatha Christie Shows No Signs of Slowing 50 Years After Her Death: 'She Has Such Enduring Appeal' Mediawan's Pierre-Antoine Capton on Buying Reese Witherspoon’s Hello Sunshine and Doubling Down on Hollywood Amid Consolidation (EXCLUSIVE) Ku was previously Disney’s vice president of AI and engineering in its office of technology enablement, where he worked on expanding AI tools across the company and researching AI-native production pipelines. He also helped connect Disney and OpenAI team members during the short-lived $1 billion deal to license Disney characters for OpenAI’s Sora video generator. “Hans knows what it takes to move emerging technology from experimentation into an organization operating at global scale,” Shen said in a statement. “From developing tools for animators early in his career to helping lead Disney’s collaboration with OpenAI on Sora, Hans has consistently worked at the intersection of creative ambition and emerging technology. He brings that experience to a studio where filmmakers and technology teams develop tools together on active productions. That combination is critical to where Utopai Studios is going next. We are building a global studio for a new era of entertainment, and Hans will be central to scaling the technology and infrastructure that make that possible.” Ku, who also worked at Walt Disney Feature Animation and DreamWorks Animation, said Utopai “has the opportunity to build something fundamentally different” due to the close collaboration between its studio and product sides. “We can take what we learn from real productions, turn those lessons directly into better products and workflows, and then bring those capabilities to filmmakers and studios around the world,” Ku said in a statement. “My focus is on building PAI alongside filmmakers, giving them better tools to explore ideas, refine their work, and bring their creative vision to the screen while keeping creative decisions in their hands.” Utopai has tried to cement itself as a premier production studio in the AI age, raising $60 million last month at a $1 billion valuation. It has also amassed an extensive slate of projects, both AI-generated and AI-enabled, including an Antonio Banderas-led live-action film “Cortés” and an AI-assisted animated feature-length adaptation of “ The Most Serious Fart ,” a 2023 children’s book written by “Not Another Teen Movie” screenwriter Mike Bender . It also partnered with the Chinese production company Huace to produce a fully AI-generated adaptation of “Journey to the West: The Lost Five Hundred Years,” an origin story of the 1592 Chinese mythological book. “Cortés,” “The Most Serious Fart” and the live-action feature “Half Moon’ are set for release sometime next year. articles.full_text: × Nov 2, 2026 10:23am PT John Goodman Says ‘Digger’ Was ‘Killed’ by Critics ‘Before We Even Opened’ and ‘It Hurt’ By Zack Sharf Plus Icon Zack Sharf Digital News Director ZSharf Latest John Goodman Says ‘Digger’ Was ‘Killed’ by Critics ‘Before We Even Opened’ and ‘It Hurt’ 41 minutes ago Jennifer Lawrence Says ‘Absolutely F—ing Not’ to Transforming Into X-Men’s Mystique Again 3 days ago Jessica Lange Hints at Acting Retirement: ‘I Feel Like I’m Coming to an End… It Doesn’t Seem Easy to Get Things Made Anymore’ 3 days ago See All Add us as a Google Preferred Source Seoju Park /© Warner Bros. /Courtesy Everett Collection John Goodman is finally speaking out about “ Digger ” flopping with critics and at the box office. During an appearance on the “Happy Sad Confused” podcast, the actor said all of the negative pre-release buzz for the movie effectively killed its chances of making money at the box office. “Digger” cost north of $160 million to make and only earned $15 million in its domestic box office debut. The movie has yet to cross $50 million worldwide after one month in theaters. Related Stories The Muppets Turn 50 This Year but They Nearly Didn't Get Made at All: 'It Was a Real Study in Perseverance' What's Driving Spanish TV? Spanish Drama Originals on Platforms, Renewals and Crossover Genres “People are talking. It hurt. It kinda killed us before we even opened. [The headlines like]: ‘This will only make $5.’ It was good reason for people to avoid it,” Goodman said about the response. “I am proud of it. I had a ball doing it. It was a good six months out of my life. It is a huge swing. It’s going to be around for a long time.” When asked if he still cares about what critics and audiences think of his work after so many years as a professional actor, Goodman responded: “Unfortunately I have to say that I am. I have to be very honest. I used to be less so. Maybe I am getting old and pathetic and it’s like, ‘Don’t hit me again!’ I put so much into this film and here you go. I am over it now. I am proud I did it.” However, Goodman noted that “everything I have done for the Coen Brothers flopped initially… so who cares, man? I still have people coming up to me in the streets asking me about ‘Barton Fink’ and ‘Big Lebowski.'” Goodman starred opposite Tom Cruise in “Digger,” directed by Alejandro G. Iñárritu. Cruise plays an oil tycoon who is faced with the end of the world after one of his rigs in Antartica malfunctions and sends ice caps hurtling towards Europe. Goodman stars as the U.S. president. The movie strongly divided critics (53% on Rotten Tomatoes) and needed an estimated $350 million just to break even in theaters. It will now go down as one of the most costly studio flops in Hollywood history by losing Warner Bros. around $250 million in theaters. Amid the movie’s disastrous box office run, various Hollywood celebrities rallied around Cruise and the movie. Neil Young posted on his website that “Digger” is “the best film I have ever seen.” Mandy Patinkin agreed, hailing Cruise’s latest as an “instant classic” and “one of the greatest pieces of film I have ever seen in my entire life.” Anne Hathaway, Jane Fonda, Ben Affleck and more also sung the movie’s praises, with Affleck condemning the public bashing of the movie. “Everybody wants to celebrate this bomb as if it’s the most exciting thing to happen. And you think like, it’s a pretty ambitious, interesting movie made by interesting people who have talent,” Affleck said in his own “Happy Sad Confused” interview last month. “Everybody wants to count the money, what it lost or whatever. To me, I just think, if you punish movies that take risks, guess what you’re going to get? A bunch of shitty homogenized movies. You cannot do something interesting without taking a big swing. And that means you’re going to sometimes look bad.” Watch Goodman’s full interview on the “Happy Sad Confused” podcast below.
